  'SerbiSure is a capstone research project of the Department of Information Technology, College of Information and Computing, University of Science and Technology of Southern Philippines (USTP), Cagayan de Oro City. It responds to the informal domestic-work economy by helping Homeowners and Kasambahays connect, document engagements, and access safer, more accountable household work under Republic Act No. 10361, the Batas Kasambahay.': ['Ang SerbiSure ay isang capstone research project ng Department of Information Technology, College of Information and Computing, University of Science and Technology of Southern Philippines (USTP), Cagayan de Oro City. Tinutugunan nito ang impormal na ekonomiya ng gawaing pantahanan sa pamamagitan ng pagtulong sa mga Homeowner at Kasambahay na mag-ugnayan, magdokumento ng engagement, at makakuha ng mas ligtas at mas pananagutang trabaho sa bahay sa ilalim ng Republic Act No. 10361, ang Batas Kasambahay.', 'Ang SerbiSure usa ka proyekto sa panukiduki sa capstone sa Department of Information Technology, College of Information and Computing, University of Science and Technology of Southern Philippines (USTP), Cagayan de Oro City. Gitubag niini ang impormal nga ekonomiya sa trabaho sa panimalay pinaagi sa pagtabang sa mga Homeowner ug Kasambahay nga magkonektar, magdokumento sa mga engagement, ug maka-access og mas luwas ug mas may tulubagon nga trabaho sa panimalay ubos sa Republic Act No. 10361, ang Batas Kasambahay.'],

  '1. Eligibility and Account Responsibility': ['1. Kwalipikasyon at Pananagutan sa Account', '1. Kwalipikasyon ug Responsibilidad sa Account'],
  'You must provide accurate information, keep your account credentials secure, and be at least 18 years old to use SerbiSure.': ['Kailangan mong magbigay ng tumpak na impormasyon, panatilihing ligtas ang iyong mga detalye sa account, at hindi bababa sa 18 taong gulang upang magamit ang SerbiSure.', 'Kinahanglan kang mohatag og tukmang impormasyon, magpabiling luwas ang imong mga detalye sa account, ug labing menos 18 anyos aron magamit ang SerbiSure.'],
  '2. Using the Platform': ['2. Paggamit ng Platform', '2. Paggamit sa Plataporma'],
  'SerbiSure helps Homeowners and Kasambahays discover services, communicate, and arrange bookings.   '3. Verification and Safety': ['3. Beripikasyon at Kaligtasan', '3. Pagpamatuod ug Kaluwasan'],
  "Verification supports trust on the platform but does not guarantee a user's identity, qualifications, conduct, or the outcome of a booking. Gamita ang imong kaugalingong paghukom ug sunda ang angay nga giya sa kaluwasan.'],
  'Homeowners must submit a valid PhilSys National ID. Kasambahays must submit valid NBI and PNP Clearances. Kailangang magsumite ang mga Kasambahay ng balidong NBI at PNP Clearance. Ang peke, hiniram, binago, o expired na credential ay maaaring magresulta sa agarang suspensyon at pag-uulat sa mga kinauukulang awtoridad.', 'Kinahanglan magsumite ang mga Homeowner og balidong PhilSys National ID.   '4. Bookings, Payments, and Reviews': ['4. Mga Booking, Bayad, at Rebyu', '4. Mga Booking, Bayad, ug Rebyu'],
  'Users are responsible for agreeing on service details, schedules, rates, and payment arrangements.   'Short-term on-demand bookings between the same Homeowner and Kasambahay are limited to three (3) bookings per calendar month. Reaching the cap triggers a programmatic block and requires the parties to consider a formal long-term contract so recurring work is not misclassified as gig work.': ['Ang panandaliang on-demand booking sa pagitan ng parehong Homeowner at Kasambahay ay limitado sa tatlong (3) booking bawat buwan ng kalendaryo. Kapag naabot ang limitasyon, awtomatikong haharang ang system at kailangang isaalang-alang ng mga partido ang pormal na pangmatagalang kontrata upang hindi maituring na gig work ang paulit-ulit na trabaho.', 'Ang hamubong on-demand booking tali sa samang Homeowner ug Kasambahay limitado sa tulo (3) ka booking matag buwan sa kalendaryo. Kung maabot ang limit, awtomatikong mobabag ang sistema ug kinahanglan hunahunaon sa mga partido ang pormal nga dugayng kontrata aron dili maisip nga gig work ang balik-balik nga trabaho.'],
  'After a completed engagement, users must submit a review.   '5. Wage Floor and Platform Role': ['5. Minimum na Sahod at Papel ng Platform', '5. Minimum nga Sweldo ug Papel sa Plataporma'],
  'Job offers and booking compensation must meet or exceed the applicable RTWPB-10 minimum wage floor for Northern Mindanao and Cagayan de Oro City.   'SerbiSure is a technology facilitator and matching marketplace. It is not a Private Employment Agency, employer, or party to the employment contract between a Homeowner and Kasambahay.   '6. Scope and Safety Boundaries': ['6. Saklaw at Hangganan sa Kaligtasan', '6. Sakop ug mga Utlanan sa Kaluwasan'],

  '7. Required Credentials and Reviews': ['7. Mga Kinakailangang Credential at Rebyu', '7. Gikinahanglang mga Credential ug Rebyu'],
  'Submitting a counterfeit, borrowed, altered, or expired government credential is fraudulent conduct. It may lead to immediate profile suspension and referral to local authorities.   'Verification documents, liveness media, and account records are retained only for as long as needed for verification, safety, legal compliance, and documented platform operations.': ['Pinananatili ang mga verification document, liveness media, at tala ng account sa panahong kailangan lamang para sa beripikasyon, kaligtasan, pagsunod sa batas, at dokumentadong operasyon ng platform.', 'Tipigan lamang ang mga verification document, liveness media, ug rekord sa account kutob sa gikinahanglan alang sa pagpamatuod, kaluwasan, pagsunod sa balaod, ug dokumentadong operasyon sa plataporma.'],
  'Expired or rejected clearances are marked for review and disposal according to applicable retention requirements.   'Account passwords are salted and hashed using industry-standard cryptography; passwords are never stored in plain text.': ['Nilalagyan ng salt at hash ang mga password gamit ang pamantayang cryptography; hindi kailanman iniimbak ang password bilang simpleng teksto.', 'Gibutangan og salt ug hash ang mga password gamit ang standard nga cryptography; dili gayod tipigan ang password isip ordinaryong teksto.'],

export type AppLanguage = 'English' | 'Tagalog' | 'Bisaya' | 'Cebuano';
export type MessageParams = Readonly<Record<string, string | number>>;

export function translateMessage(language: AppLanguage, source: string, params: MessageParams = {}): string {
  // Legacy cached feeds store generated relative labels instead of timestamps.
  const relative = /^(Posted )?(\d+)([mhd]) ago$/.exec(source);
  if (relative) return translateMessage(language, `${relative[1] || ''}{count}${relative[3]} ago`, { count: relative[2]! });
  const entry = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(UI_MESSAGES, source)
    ? (UI_MESSAGES as Record<string, readonly [string, string]>)[source] : undefined;
  const text = language === 'English' || !entry ? source : entry[language === 'Tagalog' ? 0 : 1];
  return text.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (token, key: string) => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(params, key) ? String(params[key]) : token);
}

const MONTHS = {
  English: ['January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December'],
  Tagalog: ['Enero', 'Pebrero', 'Marso', 'Abril', 'Mayo', 'Hunyo', 'Hulyo', 'Agosto', 'Setyembre', 'Oktubre', 'Nobyembre', 'Disyembre'],
  Bisaya: ['Enero', 'Pebrero', 'Marso', 'Abril', 'Mayo', 'Hunyo', 'Hulyo', 'Agosto', 'Septiyembre', 'Oktubre', 'Nobiyembre', 'Disyembre'],
};
const MONTHS_SHORT = {
  English: ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'],
  Tagalog: ['Ene', 'Peb', 'Mar', 'Abr', 'May', 'Hun', 'Hul', 'Ago', 'Set', 'Okt', 'Nob', 'Dis'],
  Bisaya: ['Ene', 'Peb', 'Mar', 'Abr', 'May', 'Hun', 'Hul', 'Ago', 'Sep', 'Okt', 'Nob', 'Dis'],
};
const DAYS = {
  English: ['Sunday', 'Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday'],
  Tagalog: ['Linggo', 'Lunes', 'Martes', 'Miyerkules', 'Huwebes', 'Biyernes', 'Sabado'],
  Bisaya: ['Domingo', 'Lunes', 'Martes', 'Miyerkules', 'Huwebes', 'Biyernes', 'Sabado'],
};

// Use explicit Cebuano names: Android Intl may silently fall back to English.
export function formatLocalizedDate(language: AppLanguage, value: Date | string, style: 'greeting' | 'monthYear' | 'full' | 'compact' = 'full'): string {
  if (!value) return '';
  let date: Date;
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    const trimmed = value.trim();
    const mmddyyyy = /^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})$/.exec(trimmed);
    const yyyymmdd = /^(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})/.exec(trimmed);
    if (mmddyyyy) {
      date = new Date(Number(mmddyyyy[3]), Number(mmddyyyy[1]) - 1, Number(mmddyyyy[2]));
    } else if (yyyymmdd) {
      date = new Date(Number(yyyymmdd[1]), Number(yyyymmdd[2]) - 1, Number(yyyymmdd[3]));
    } else {
      date = new Date(trimmed);
    }
  } else {
    date = value;
  }
  if (!date || Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return '';
  const key = language === 'Cebuano' ? 'Bisaya' : language;
  const month = MONTHS[key][date.getMonth()];
  const shortMonth = MONTHS_SHORT[key][date.getMonth()];
  if (style === 'greeting') return `${DAYS[key][date.getDay()]}, ${month} ${date.getDate()}`;
  if (style === 'monthYear') return `${month} ${date.getFullYear()}`;
  if (style === 'compact') return `${shortMonth} ${date.getDate()}, ${date.getFullYear()}`;
  return `${month} ${date.getDate()}, ${date.getFullYear()}`;
}

def validate_user_tags(value):

    if not isinstance(value, list):
        raise ValidationError("User tags must be a list")
    
    if len(value) > 10:
        raise ValidationError("You can add a maximum of 10 tags.")

    for tag in value:
        if not isinstance(tag, str):
            raise ValidationError("Each user tags must be text")
        
        if len(tag) > 15:
            raise ValidationError(f"Tag '{tag}' exceeds 15 characters")


def validate_social_links(value):
    if not isinstance(value, list):
        raise ValidationError("Social links must be a list.")
    
    if len(value) > 5:
        raise ValidationError("You can add a maximum of 5 social accounts.")

    for item in value:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValidationError("Each social link must be an object containing 'platform' and 'url'.")
        url = item.get('url', '')
        if not isinstance(url, str) or len(url) > 255:
            raise ValidationError("Each social link URL must be a string up to 255 characters.")


class CustomUserManager(BaseUserManager):

    def create_user(self, email, password=None, **extra_fields):
        if not email:
            raise ValueError('The email field must be set')
        
        email = self.normalize_email(email)
        desired_status = extra_fields.pop('verification_status', None)

        if not extra_fields.get('contact_number'):
            import hashlib
            h = int(hashlib.md5(email.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()[:8], 16) % 900000000 + 100000000
            extra_fields['contact_number'] = f"+639{h}"

        user = self.model(email=email, **extra_fields)
        user.set_password(password)
        user.save(using=self._db)

        if desired_status == 'Verified':
            from verifications.models import tbl_documents
            if user.account_type == 'Homeowner':
                tbl_documents.objects.get_or_create(
                    user_profile=user,
                    document_type='national_id_front',
                    defaults={'document_url': 'seed_id_front', 'verification_status': 'Verified'}
                )
                tbl_documents.objects.get_or_create(
                    user_profile=user,
                    document_type='national_id_back',
                    defaults={'document_url': 'seed_id_back', 'verification_status': 'Verified'}
                )
            elif user.account_type == 'Kasambahay':
                tbl_documents.objects.get_or_create(
                    user_profile=user,
                    document_type='nbi_clearance',
                    defaults={'document_url': 'seed_nbi', 'verification_status': 'Verified'}
                )
                tbl_documents.objects.get_or_create(
                    user_profile=user,
                    document_type='police_clearance',
                    defaults={'document_url': 'seed_police', 'verification_status': 'Verified'}
                )
        return user

    
    def create_superuser(self, email, password=None, **extra_fields):
        extra_fields.setdefault('is_staff', True)
        extra_fields.setdefault('is_superuser', True)
        extra_fields.setdefault('account_type', 'Admin')

        return self.create_user(email, password, **extra_fields)

"""Scoped reads and atomic, audited manual adjustments of existing monthly points."""
from datetime import datetime

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.db import IntegrityError, transaction
from django.db.models import Q, Value
from django.db.models.functions import Concat
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from rest_framework.exceptions import APIException, PermissionDenied, ValidationError

from booking.models import tbl_booking
from chat.services import RESIDENT_ROLES, is_superadmin, jurisdiction, jurisdiction_parts, location_key
from realtime.events import publish
from .penalties import PH_TIME, current_penalty_month, refresh_monthly_penalties
from .penalty_models import PenaltyAdjustment


def assert_official(actor):
    if not actor.is_active or actor.is_account_suspended or not (
        is_superadmin(actor) or (actor.account_type == 'Barangay' and jurisdiction(actor))
    ):
        raise PermissionDenied('Only authorized administrators can manage penalty points.')


def resident_queryset(actor, filters=None):
    assert_official(actor)
    filters = filters or {}
    users = get_user_model().objects.filter(account_type__in=RESIDENT_ROLES, is_staff=False, is_superuser=False)
    # Reuse the saved-profile policy, including normalized city and province. One
    # lightweight location query avoids trusting a client-supplied barangay.
    if actor.account_type == 'Barangay':
        key = jurisdiction(actor)
        ids = [user.pk for user in users.only('id', 'barangay', 'city', 'province') if jurisdiction(user) == key]
        users = users.filter(pk__in=ids)
    elif filters.get('barangay') and filters['barangay'] not in ('All Barangays', 'ALL'):
        key = location_key(filters['barangay'], barangay=True)
        covered = {location_key(value, barangay=True) for value in get_user_model().objects.filter(
            account_type='Barangay', is_active=True).values_list('barangay', flat=True)} if key == 'unassigned' else set()
        ids = [user.pk for user in users.only('id', 'barangay') if (
            location_key(user.barangay, barangay=True) not in covered if key == 'unassigned'
            else location_key(user.barangay, barangay=True) == key)]
        users = users.filter(pk__in=ids)
    if filters.get('role'):
        users = users.filter(account_type=filters['role'])
    if filters.get('points'):
        # Match the effective score shown in the portal, including last month's
        # points appearing as zero without writing a reset during a list request.
        month = current_penalty_month()
        if filters['points'] == '0':
            users = users.filter(Q(penalty_month__lt=month) | Q(penalty_points=0))
        else:
            users = users.filter(penalty_month__gte=month)
            if filters['points'] == 'with_penalties':
                users = users.filter(penalty_points__gt=0)
            else:
                users = users.filter(penalty_points=int(filters['points']))
    if filters.get('search'):
        term = filters['search']
        users = users.annotate(full_name=Concat('first_name', Value(' '), 'last_name')).filter(
            Q(full_name__icontains=term) | Q(username__icontains=term) | Q(barangay__icontains=term))
    return users.order_by('first_name', 'last_name', 'id')


def effective_points(user):
    return user.penalty_points if user.penalty_month >= current_penalty_month() else 0


def cancellations_for(user):
    month = current_penalty_month()
    since = datetime(month.year, month.month, 1, tzinfo=PH_TIME)
    return tbl_booking.objects.filter(cancelled_by=user, booking_status='Cancelled', cancelled_at__gte=since).order_by('-cancelled_at', '-pk')


def adjustment_history(actor, filters=None):
    assert_official(actor)
    filters = filters or {}
    records = PenaltyAdjustment.objects.all()
    if actor.account_type == 'Barangay':
        key = jurisdiction(actor)
        records = records.filter(barangay_key=key[0], city_key=key[1], province_key=key[2])
    elif filters.get('barangay') and filters['barangay'] not in ('All Barangays', 'ALL'):
        key = location_key(filters['barangay'], barangay=True)
        if key == 'unassigned':
            covered = [location_key(value, barangay=True) for value in get_user_model().objects.filter(
                account_type='Barangay', is_active=True).values_list('barangay', flat=True)]
            records = records.exclude(barangay_key__in=covered)
        else:
            records = records.filter(barangay_key=key)
    if filters.get('user_id'):
        records = records.filter(user_id_snapshot=filters['user_id'])
    if filters.get('role'):
        records = records.filter(user_role=filters['role'])
    if filters.get('search'):
        term = filters['search']
        records = records.filter(Q(user_name__icontains=term) | Q(admin_name__icontains=term)
            | Q(user_barangay__icontains=term) | Q(incident_reference__icontains=term))
    return records


def conflict(message='Points changed. Refresh before adjusting.'):
    error = APIException({'detail': message})
    error.status_code = 409
    raise error


@transaction.atomic
def adjust_points(actor, user_id, data):
    people = {user.pk: user for user in get_user_model().objects.select_for_update().filter(
        pk__in=[actor.pk, user_id]).order_by('pk')}
    actor = people.get(actor.pk)
    if actor is None:
        raise PermissionDenied('Your administrator account is unavailable.')
    # Recheck scope against the locked profiles, never the supplied role/filter.
    get_object_or_404(resident_queryset(actor), pk=user_id)
    user = people[user_id]
    existing = PenaltyAdjustment.objects.filter(request_id=data['request_id']).first()
    if existing:
        same = (existing.admin_id_snapshot == actor.pk and existing.user_id_snapshot == user.pk
            and existing.points_delta == data['points_delta'] and existing.reason == data['reason']
            and existing.penalty_month == data['expected_month'] and existing.points_before == data['expected_points']
            and existing.report_verified == data['report_verified'] and existing.incident_reference == data['incident_reference']
            and existing.booking_id_snapshot == data.get('booking_id'))
        if not same:
            conflict('This request was already used. Refresh and try again.')
        return user, existing, False
    month = current_penalty_month()
    refresh_monthly_penalties(user)
    if data['expected_month'] != month or user.penalty_month != month or data['expected_points'] != user.penalty_points:
        conflict()
    points = user.penalty_points + data['points_delta']
    if not 0 <= points <= 3:
        raise ValidationError({'detail': 'The new score must be between 0 and 3 points.'})
    booking_id = data.get('booking_id')
    if booking_id and not cancellations_for(user).filter(pk=booking_id).exists():
        raise ValidationError({'detail': 'Choose one of this user’s cancellations from this month.'})
    before = user.penalty_points
    user.penalty_points = points
    user.is_restricted = points >= 3
    user.save(update_fields=['penalty_points', 'is_restricted'])
    key = jurisdiction_parts(user)
    try:
        record = PenaltyAdjustment.objects.create(
            request_id=data['request_id'], user_id_snapshot=user.pk,
            user_name=user.get_full_name().strip() or user.username, user_role=user.account_type,
            user_barangay=user.barangay or '', barangay_key=key[0], city_key=key[1], province_key=key[2],
            admin_id_snapshot=actor.pk, admin_name=actor.get_full_name().strip() or actor.username,
            admin_role=actor.account_type, points_delta=data['points_delta'], points_before=before,
            points_after=points, penalty_month=month, reason=data['reason'],
            report_verified=data['report_verified'], incident_reference=data['incident_reference'],
            booking_id_snapshot=booking_id)
    except IntegrityError:
        conflict('This request was already used. Refresh and try again.')
    publish([user.pk, actor.pk], {'type': 'booking.changed', 'booking_id': str(booking_id) if booking_id else None})
    return user, record, True

import uuid

from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.db import models
from django.db.models import F, Q


class PenaltyAuditQuerySet(models.QuerySet):
    def update(self, **kwargs):
        raise ValidationError('Penalty history cannot be edited.')

    def delete(self):
        raise ValidationError('Penalty history cannot be deleted.')

    def bulk_update(self, objs, fields, batch_size=None):
        raise ValidationError('Penalty history cannot be edited.')


class PenaltyAdjustment(models.Model):
    id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    request_id = models.UUIDField(unique=True, editable=False)
    user_id_snapshot = models.UUIDField(db_index=True, editable=False)
    user_name = models.CharField(max_length=255)
    user_role = models.CharField(max_length=20)
    user_barangay = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True)
    barangay_key = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True)
    city_key = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True)
    province_key = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True)
    admin_id_snapshot = models.UUIDField(editable=False)
    admin_name = models.CharField(max_length=255)
    admin_role = models.CharField(max_length=50)
    points_delta = models.SmallIntegerField()
    points_before = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField()
    points_after = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField()
    penalty_month = models.DateField()
    reason = models.TextField(max_length=2000)
    report_verified = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    incident_reference = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True)
    booking_id_snapshot = models.UUIDField(null=True, blank=True, editable=False)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    objects = PenaltyAuditQuerySet.as_manager()

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'tbl_penalty_adjustment'
        ordering = ['-created_at', '-id']
        default_permissions = ('view',)
        indexes = [models.Index(fields=['barangay_key', 'city_key', 'province_key'], name='penalty_audit_scope_idx')]
        constraints = [
            models.CheckConstraint(condition=Q(points_before__lte=3, points_after__lte=3), name='penalty_audit_score_range'),
            models.CheckConstraint(condition=Q(points_delta__in=[-3, -2, -1, 1, 2, 3]), name='penalty_audit_nonzero_delta'),
            models.CheckConstraint(condition=Q(points_after=F('points_before') + F('points_delta')), name='penalty_audit_score_matches'),
        ]

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if not self._state.adding or kwargs.get('update_fields') or kwargs.get('force_update'):
            raise ValidationError('Penalty history cannot be edited.')
        kwargs['force_insert'] = True
        return super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def delete(self, *args, **kwargs):
        raise ValidationError('Penalty history cannot be deleted.')

"""Profile image persistence and upload timing, without logging image or user data."""
from time import perf_counter

import cloudinary.uploader
from rest_framework.exceptions import APIException


def save_profile_image(user, image_file):
    from verifications.services.profile_photos import check_photo_upload, save_photo_submission
    check_photo_upload(user)
    started_at = perf_counter()
    result = cloudinary.uploader.upload(
        image_file,
        folder='serbisure_profiles/',
        type='authenticated',
    )
    cloudinary_ms = (perf_counter() - started_at) * 1000
    public_id = result.get('public_id')
    if not public_id:
        raise APIException('Your selfie could not be saved. Please retry.')

    started_at = perf_counter()
    if user.account_type in ('Homeowner', 'Kasambahay'):
        save_photo_submission(user, public_id)
    else:
        user.profile_link = public_id
        user.save(update_fields=['profile_link'])
    return {
        'cloudinary': cloudinary_ms,
        'profile_save': (perf_counter() - started_at) * 1000,
    }

        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(self.stats).status_code, 401)

import uuid
from unittest.mock import patch

from django.core.cache import cache
from django.test import SimpleTestCase, override_settings
from rest_framework.test import APIRequestFactory

from .serializers import UserRegistrationSerializer
from .views import LoginThrottle, RegistrationThrottle, UserRegistrationView


@override_settings(CACHES={
    'default': {'BACKEND': 'django.core.cache.backends.locmem.LocMemCache',
                'LOCATION': 'registration-throttle-tests'},
})
class RegistrationThrottleTests(SimpleTestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.factory = APIRequestFactory()
        cache.clear()
        self.addCleanup(cache.clear)
        self.clock = self.enterContext(patch.object(RegistrationThrottle, 'timer', return_value=1000.0))
        self.serializer_class = self.enterContext(patch('accounts.views.UserRegistrationSerializer'))
        self.serializer = self.serializer_class.return_value
        self.serializer.is_valid.return_value = False
        self.serializer.errors = {
            'email': ['Enter a valid email address.'],
            'contact_number': ['Enter a valid mobile number.'],
            'first_name': ['This field is required.'],
        }

    def submit(self, key=None, data=None):
        request = self.factory.post('/api/v1/accounts/register/', data or {}, format='json',
                                    HTTP_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=key or str(uuid.uuid4()))
        return UserRegistrationView.as_view()(request)

    def test_invalid_submissions_keep_field_errors_and_never_create_accounts(self):
        for _ in range(5):
            response = self.submit()
            self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)
            self.assertEqual(response.data, self.serializer.errors)
        self.serializer.save.assert_not_called()

    def test_real_validation_rejects_invalid_email_phone_and_missing_fields(self):
        # Keep real field validators while treating the account directory as empty.
        with patch('accounts.views.UserRegistrationSerializer', UserRegistrationSerializer), \
                patch('django.db.models.query.QuerySet.exists', return_value=False):
            for payload in ({}, {'email': 'invalid-email'}, {'contact_number': '123'}):
                response = self.submit(data=payload)
                self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)
                self.assertIn('email', response.data)
                self.assertIn('contact_number', response.data)
                self.assertNotIn('access', response.data)

    def test_sixth_attempt_has_five_minute_retry_header_and_clear_failure_copy(self):
        for _ in range(5):
            self.submit()
        response = self.submit()
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 429)
        self.assertEqual(response['Retry-After'], '300')
        self.assertIn('No account was created by this attempt.', str(response.data['detail']))
        self.assertIn('5 minutes', str(response.data['detail']))
        self.assertNotIn('hours', str(response.data['detail']))
        self.serializer.save.assert_not_called()

    def test_retry_at_five_minute_boundary_is_allowed_and_blocked_calls_do_not_extend_it(self):
        for _ in range(5):
            self.submit()
        self.clock.return_value = 1299.0
        response = self.submit()
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 429)
        self.assertEqual(response['Retry-After'], '1')
        self.clock.return_value = 1300.0
        self.assertEqual(self.submit().status_code, 400)
        self.serializer.save.assert_not_called()

    def test_login_or_old_daily_counter_does_not_block_registration(self):
        request = self.factory.post('/api/v1/accounts/register/')
        request.user = None
        login_key = LoginThrottle().get_cache_key(request, None)
        registration_key = RegistrationThrottle().get_cache_key(request, None)
        self.assertNotEqual(login_key, registration_key)
        cache.set(login_key, [1000.0] * 5, 86400)
        self.assertEqual(self.submit().status_code, 400)

    def test_confirmed_success_keeps_tokens_and_idempotent_replay(self):
        self.serializer.is_valid.return_value = True
        self.serializer.errors = {}
        token = self.enterContext(patch('accounts.views.CustomLoginSerializer.get_token')).return_value
        token.__str__.return_value = 'refresh-token'
        token.access_token = 'access-token'
        key = str(uuid.uuid4())
        first = self.submit(key)
        second = self.submit(key)
        self.assertEqual(first.status_code, 201)
        self.assertEqual(second.status_code, 201)
        self.assertEqual(first.data['access'], 'access-token')
        self.assertEqual(first.data['refresh'], 'refresh-token')
        self.assertEqual(first.data, second.data)
        self.serializer.save.assert_called_once()

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from unittest.mock import patch
from django.urls import reverse
from django.db import transaction
from rest_framework.test import APITestCase
from .test_admin_statistics import AdminStatisticsTests
from .models import tbl_user_profile as User, tbl_worker_profile, tbl_worker_status_history as History
from .workforce import PH_TIME
from verifications.models import tbl_documents as Document


class WorkforceTests(APITestCase):
    """Real document/status writes, month-end boundaries, jurisdiction and profile skills."""
    setUp = AdminStatisticsTests.setUp
    user = AdminStatisticsTests.user
    def test_partial_rejected_pending_expired_and_replaced_clearances_are_not_verified(self):
        for kind in ('nbi_clearance', 'police_clearance'):
            Document.objects.create(user_profile=self.worker, document_type=kind, document_url='replacement', verification_status='Pending')
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(self.stats).data['metrics']['totalWorkers'], 0)
        for status in ('Unverified', 'Rejected', 'Verified'):
            worker = self.user('Kasambahay', 'Pagatpat', is_on_job=True)
            Document.objects.create(user_profile=worker, document_type='profile_photo', document_url='test/face', verification_status='Verified')
            Document.objects.create(user_profile=worker, document_type='nbi_clearance', document_url='nbi', verification_status='Verified')
            if status != 'Unverified':
                Document.objects.create(user_profile=worker, document_type='police_clearance', document_url='police', verification_status=status)
            expected = 1 if status == 'Verified' else 0
            self.assertEqual(self.client.get(self.stats).data['metrics']['totalWorkers'], expected)
        doc = worker.documents.get(document_type='police_clearance')
        doc.valid_until = datetime.now(PH_TIME).date() - timedelta(days=1); doc.save()
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(self.stats).data['metrics']['totalWorkers'], 0)

    def test_registration_verification_toggle_and_rollback_are_atomic(self):
        worker = self.user('Kasambahay', 'Agusan')
        entries = History.objects.filter(worker=worker)
        self.assertEqual(entries.count(), 1)
        self.assertFalse(entries.get().status)
        for kind in ('nbi_clearance', 'police_clearance', 'profile_photo'):
            Document.objects.create(user_profile=worker, document_type=kind, document_url='clearance', verification_status='Verified')
        self.assertEqual(entries.count(), 2)
        self.assertTrue(entries.latest('changed_at').is_verified)
        self.client.force_authenticate(worker)
        for value in (True, True, False):
            result = self.client.patch(reverse('job-status'), {'is_on_job': value}, format='json')
            self.assertEqual(result.status_code, 200, result.data)
        self.assertEqual(entries.count(), 4)  # Repeated same-value request is not a change.
        self.assertFalse(entries.latest('changed_at').status)
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError), transaction.atomic():
            worker.is_on_job = True; worker.save(update_fields=['is_on_job'])
            raise RuntimeError('rollback')
        worker.refresh_from_db(); self.assertFalse(worker.is_on_job)
        self.assertEqual(entries.count(), 4)
        with patch('accounts.workforce.record_worker_status', side_effect=RuntimeError('history unavailable')):
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                self.client.patch(reverse('job-status'), {'is_on_job': True}, format='json')
        worker.refresh_from_db(); self.assertFalse(worker.is_on_job)
        self.assertEqual(entries.count(), 4)
        self.client.force_authenticate(self.owner)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.patch(reverse('job-status'), {'is_on_job': True}, format='json').status_code, 403)

    def test_skills_count_unique_verified_profiles_and_follow_barangay(self):
        tbl_worker_profile.objects.create(user=self.worker, service_categories=['Cleaning', 'Cooking', 'Cleaning'])
        other = self.user('Kasambahay', 'Agusan', verification_status='Verified')
        tbl_worker_profile.objects.create(user=other, service_categories=['All-around'])
        unverified = self.user('Kasambahay', 'Pagatpat')
        tbl_worker_profile.objects.create(user=unverified, service_categories=['Cooking'])
        city = self.client.get(self.stats).data['skills']
        self.assertEqual(city['totalWorkers'], 2)
        cleaning = next(row for row in city['categories'] if row['category'] == 'Cleaning')
        self.assertEqual(cleaning, {'category': 'Cleaning', 'count': 1, 'percentage': 50.0})
        local = self.client.get(self.stats, {'barangay': 'Pagatpat'}).data['skills']
        self.assertEqual(local['totalWorkers'], 1)
        self.assertEqual(next(row for row in local['categories'] if row['category'] == 'Cooking')['percentage'], 100)

    def test_month_end_uses_latest_event_at_ph_midnight_and_preserves_old_scope_and_verification(self):
        worker_id = self.worker.pk
        History.objects.all().delete()
        def event(at, **values):
            row = History.objects.create(worker=self.worker, worker_id_snapshot=worker_id, status=False, barangay='Pagatpat', is_verified=True)
            History.objects.filter(pk=row.pk).update(changed_at=datetime.fromisoformat(at).replace(tzinfo=PH_TIME), **values)
        event('2026-07-01T00:00:00', is_verified=False)
        event('2026-08-01T00:00:00')
        event('2026-08-31T23:59:59.999999', status=True)
        event('2026-09-01T00:00:00', status=False, barangay='Agusan')
        event('2026-10-01T00:00:00', is_verified=False)
        self.worker.barangay = 'Agusan'; self.worker.is_on_job = False
        self.worker.save(update_fields=['barangay', 'is_on_job'])
        url = reverse('admin-monthly-trend')
        with patch('accounts.workforce.timezone.now', return_value=datetime(2026, 10, 19, tzinfo=PH_TIME)):
            city = self.client.get(url).data
            self.assertFalse(city['trend'][0]['has_history'])
            self.assertIsNone(city['trend'][0]['employed'])
            self.assertEqual(city['trend'][-3]['employed'], 1)  # August: exact last microsecond
            self.assertEqual(city['trend'][-2]['available'], 1)  # September: new address
            self.assertEqual(city['trend'][-1]['available'], 1)  # October: live documents + toggle
            local = self.client.get(url, {'barangay': 'Pagatpat'}).data
            self.assertEqual(local['trend'][-3]['employed'], 1)
            self.assertEqual(local['trend'][-2]['total'], 0)
            self.assertEqual(local['trend'][-1]['total'], 0)

    def test_document_revocation_and_account_deletion_keep_history(self):
        old_id = self.worker.pk
        self.worker.documents.get(document_type='police_clearance').delete()
        self.assertFalse(History.objects.filter(worker=self.worker).latest('changed_at').is_verified)
        self.worker.delete()
        rows = History.objects.filter(worker_id_snapshot=old_id)
        self.assertGreater(rows.count(), 1)
        self.assertFalse(rows.latest('changed_at').is_verified)
        self.assertFalse(rows.exclude(worker=None).exists())

    def test_role_filters_require_complete_credentials_and_officers_cannot_escape_scope(self):
        url = reverse('admin-verification-status-stats')
        for role, count in (('All Roles', 2), ('Kasambahay', 1), ('Homeowner', 1)):
            data = self.client.get(url, {'role': role}).data
            self.assertEqual(data['total'], count)
            self.assertEqual(data['stats']['verified'], 0 if role == 'Homeowner' else 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(url, {'role': 'Admin'}).status_code, 400)
        officer = self.user('Barangay', 'Agusan')
        self.client.force_authenticate(officer)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(url, {'barangay': 'All Barangays'}).data['total'], 0)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(reverse('admin-monthly-trend'), {'barangay': 'Pagatpat'}).data['total_workers'], 0)
        self.client.force_authenticate(None)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(url).status_code, 401)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(reverse('admin-monthly-trend')).status_code, 401)

    def test_expired_clearance_history_is_evaluated_at_the_month_end_not_today(self):
        History.objects.all().delete()
        row = History.objects.create(worker=self.worker, worker_id_snapshot=self.worker.pk, status=True, barangay='Pagatpat',
                                     is_verified=True, clearance_valid_until=datetime(2026, 8, 31).date())
        History.objects.filter(pk=row.pk).update(changed_at=datetime(2026, 8, 1, tzinfo=PH_TIME))
        with patch('accounts.workforce.timezone.now', return_value=datetime(2026, 10, 19, tzinfo=PH_TIME)):
            points = self.client.get(reverse('admin-monthly-trend')).data['trend']
        self.assertEqual(points[-3]['employed'], 1)
        self.assertEqual(points[-2]['total'], 0)

    def test_baseline_migration_records_current_values_without_backdating(self):
        import importlib
        from django.apps import apps
        from django.db import connection
        from django.utils import timezone
        migration = importlib.import_module('accounts.migrations.0023_worker_status_history')
        History.objects.all().delete()
        before = timezone.now()
        with connection.schema_editor() as editor:
            migration.seed_current_status(apps, editor)
        row = History.objects.get(worker=self.worker)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(row.changed_at, before)
        self.assertEqual(row.status, self.worker.is_on_job)
        self.assertTrue(row.is_verified)

Run all account tests:

Run a single class:

from django.test import TestCase
from rest_framework.test import APIClient, APITestCase
from rest_framework import status
from django.core.cache import cache
from django.urls import reverse
from unittest.mock import patch
from .models import tbl_user_profile
User = tbl_user_profile
from .serializers import UserRegistrationSerializer
import uuid


# =============================================================================
# SECTION 1 — MODEL TESTS
# Purpose: Verify that the Django ORM behaves correctly at the model layer,
#          independent of any HTTP request. If these fail, the DB schema or
#          CustomUserManager has a bug.
# =============================================================================

class TestUserModels(TestCase):

    def test_create_superuser_flags_are_set(self):
        """
        GIVEN  a call to create_superuser()
        WHEN   the user is saved to the DB
        THEN   is_superuser=True, is_staff=True, and username is preserved.

        Why this matters: Superuser creation is used in production via the
        'python manage.py createsuperuser' command. If the CustomUserManager
        breaks this, no one can log into the Django admin panel.
        """
        admin = tbl_user_profile.objects.create_superuser(
            username="admin_master",
            email="admin@example.com",
            password="StrongPassword123!"
        )
        self.assertTrue(admin.is_superuser)
        self.assertTrue(admin.is_staff)
        self.assertEqual(admin.username, "admin_master")

    def test_user_tags_field_defaults_to_empty_list(self):
        """
        GIVEN  a freshly created user with no user_tags provided
        WHEN   we read user.user_tags from the DB
        THEN   it should be [] (empty list), NOT None or a string.

        Why this matters: The JSONField default=list must produce [] not null.
        If this is None, the frontend will crash trying to iterate over tags.
        """
        user = tbl_user_profile.objects.create_user(
            username="tagtest",
            email="tagtest@example.com",
            password="Password123!",
            contact_number="+639123456789"
        )
        self.assertEqual(user.user_tags, [])
        self.assertIsInstance(user.user_tags, list)

    def test_user_about_field_defaults_to_no_bio(self):
        """
        GIVEN  a freshly created user with no user_about provided
        WHEN   we read user.user_about from the DB
        THEN   it should be the string 'No Bio'

        Why this matters: The ProfileScreen renders user_about. A None value
        would cause a crash or display 'null' on the mobile UI.
        """
        user = tbl_user_profile.objects.create_user(
            username="abouttest",
            email="abouttest@example.com",
            password="Password123!",
            contact_number="+639123456789"
        )
        self.assertEqual(user.user_about, "No Bio")

    def test_duplicate_contact_number_raises_integrity_error(self):
        """
        GIVEN  an existing user with contact_number '+639111111111'
        WHEN   attempting to create another user with the exact same contact_number
        THEN   django.db.utils.IntegrityError is raised by the DB unique constraint.
        """
        from django.db import IntegrityError
        tbl_user_profile.objects.create_user(
            username="phone_dup1",
            email="phone_dup1@example.com",
            password="Password123!",
            contact_number="+639111111111"
        )
        with self.assertRaises(IntegrityError):
            tbl_user_profile.objects.create_user(
                username="phone_dup2",
                email="phone_dup2@example.com",
                password="Password123!",
                contact_number="+639111111111"
            )

    def test_model_save_auto_normalizes_local_phone_to_e164(self):
        """
        GIVEN  a user model instantiated with local 09 format '09511234568'
        WHEN   save() is called
        THEN   contact_number is automatically normalized to '+639511234568'.

# SECTION 3 — API ENDPOINT INTEGRATION TESTS
# Purpose: End-to-end HTTP tests simulating exactly what the mobile app does.
#          These tests hit the actual URL router, views, serializers, and DB.
#
# Endpoints under test:
#   POST   /api/v1/accounts/register/    → UserRegistrationView
#   POST   /api/v1/accounts/login/       → CustomLoginView
#   PATCH  /api/v1/accounts/user-about/  → UserAboutView
#   PATCH  /api/v1/accounts/user-tags/   → UserTagsView
# =============================================================================

class TestUserAPIEndpoints(TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        """
        Shared setup for all API tests.
        - Each test gets a fresh in-memory DB (Django isolates tests).
        - cache.clear() resets throttle counters between tests.
        - self.valid_payload is the minimum required to register a user.
        """
        self.client = APIClient()

        # Endpoint URLs — keep these in sync with accounts/urls.py
        self.register_url = "/api/v1/accounts/register/"
        self.login_url    = "/api/v1/accounts/login/"
        self.about_url    = "/api/v1/accounts/user-about/"
        self.tags_url     = "/api/v1/accounts/user-tags/"
        self.public_profile_base = "/api/v1/accounts/public-profile/"

        # Reset throttle counters so tests don't bleed into each other
        cache.clear()

        self.valid_payload = {
            "email": "api@example.com",
            "password": "StrongPassword123!",
            "first_name": "Naruto",
            "last_name": "Uzumaki",
            "contact_number": "+639123456789",
            "account_type": "Homeowner"
        }
        self.idempotency_key = str(uuid.uuid4())

    # ── TEST HELPER ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _create_and_login_user(
        self,
        email="testuser@example.com",
        password="StrongPassword123!",
        username="testuser",
        contact_number=None
    ):
        """
        Helper that bypasses the registration endpoint and directly creates
        a user in the DB, then logs in to get a real JWT access token.

        Returns: (user_instance, access_token_string)
        """
        if not contact_number:
            import hashlib
            h = int(hashlib.md5(email.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()[:8], 16) % 900000000 + 100000000
            contact_number = f"+639{h}"

        user = tbl_user_profile.objects.create_user(
            username=username,
            email=email,
            password=password,
            contact_number=contact_number
        )
        response = self.client.post(self.login_url, {
            "email": email,
            "password": password
        })
        token = response.data.get("access")
        return user, token

    # ── REGISTRATION TESTS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def test_register_success_returns_201_and_jwt_tokens(self):
        """
        GIVEN  valid registration data + a valid UUID Idempotency-Key
        WHEN   POST /register/
        THEN   201 Created, body contains 'access' and 'refresh' JWT tokens.

        The frontend uses these tokens immediately to log the user in
        without requiring a separate login step after registration.
        """
        response = self.client.post(
            self.register_url,
            self.valid_payload,
            HTTP_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=self.idempotency_key
        )
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
        self.assertIn("access", response.data)
        self.assertIn("refresh", response.data)

    def test_register_idempotency_double_click_safe(self):
        """
        GIVEN  the same idempotency key used on 2 identical POST requests
        WHEN   user double-taps the Register button
        THEN   only 1 user row is created in the DB; both requests return 201.

        Critical UX bug prevention: without this, a slow network + impatient
        user double-tap would create 2 accounts with the same email,
        causing an 'email already exists' error on the second attempt.
        """
        # First tap — hits the DB and creates 1 user
        self.client.post(
            self.register_url, self.valid_payload,
            HTTP_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=self.idempotency_key
        )
        self.assertEqual(tbl_user_profile.objects.count(), 1)

        # Second tap — served from cache, no DB write
        response2 = self.client.post(
            self.register_url, self.valid_payload,
            HTTP_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=self.idempotency_key
        )
        self.assertEqual(response2.status_code, status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
        self.assertEqual(tbl_user_profile.objects.count(), 1)  # Still 1!

    def test_register_missing_idempotency_key_returns_400(self):
        """
        GIVEN  a registration request with NO Idempotency-Key header
        THEN   400 Bad Request.

        The header is mandatory. The frontend must generate a UUID v4 before
        calling this endpoint.
        """
        response = self.client.post(self.register_url, self.valid_payload)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

    def test_register_non_uuid_idempotency_key_returns_400(self):
        """
        GIVEN  Idempotency-Key header contains a plain string (not a UUID)
        THEN   400 Bad Request.

        Prevents abuse: sending 'abc' as a key would bypass the idempotency
        check because it's not a valid UUID format.
        """
        response = self.client.post(
            self.register_url, self.valid_payload,
            HTTP_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY="not-a-valid-uuid"
        )
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

    def test_register_admin_account_type_blocked(self):
        """
        GIVEN  registration data with account_type='Admin'
        THEN   400 Bad Request.

        Privilege escalation guard: No one should be able to self-promote
        to Admin through the public registration API.
        """
        self.valid_payload["account_type"] = "Admin"
        response = self.client.post(
            self.register_url, self.valid_payload,
            HTTP_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=str(uuid.uuid4())
        )
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

    def test_register_duplicate_email_rejected(self):
        """
        GIVEN  a second registration attempt with the same email
        WHEN   a different Idempotency-Key is used (genuine second attempt)
        THEN   400 Bad Request — email must be unique.
        """
        # First registration — succeeds
        self.client.post(
            self.register_url, self.valid_payload,
            HTTP_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=self.idempotency_key
        )
        # Second attempt with same email but a new key — must fail
        response = self.client.post(
            self.register_url, self.valid_payload,
            HTTP_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=str(uuid.uuid4())
        )
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from rest_framework.exceptions import AuthenticationFailed
from rest_framework_simplejwt.serializers import TokenRefreshSerializer
from rest_framework_simplejwt.tokens import RefreshToken
from rest_framework_simplejwt.views import TokenRefreshView
from .authentication import assert_account_available


class AccountTokenRefreshSerializer(TokenRefreshSerializer):
    def validate(self, attrs):
        from rest_framework_simplejwt.settings import api_settings
        token = RefreshToken(attrs['refresh'])
        user = get_user_model().objects.filter(**{api_settings.USER_ID_FIELD: token[api_settings.USER_ID_CLAIM]}).first()
        if not user or not user.is_active:
            raise AuthenticationFailed('Account unavailable.')
        assert_account_available(user)
        return super().validate(attrs)


class AccountTokenRefreshView(TokenRefreshView):
    serializer_class = AccountTokenRefreshSerializer

class RegistrationThrottle(AnonRateThrottle):
    # Separate from login's anonymous counter and the previous daily limit.
    scope = 'registration_5min'
    rate = 'custom'

    def parse_rate(self, rate):
        return (5, 300)

class UserRegistrationView(APIView):

    throttle_classes = [RegistrationThrottle]

    # This tell Django: "You do not need to logged in to access this windows."
    # (Because if you had to be logged in to register...nobody could ever register!)

    authentication_classes = []
    permission_classes = []

    @extend_schema(
        request=UserRegistrationSerializer,
        parameters=[
            OpenApiParameter(
                name='Idempotency-Key',
                type=OpenApiTypes.UUID,
                location=OpenApiParameter.HEADER,
                description='A unique UUID v4 string to prevent duplicate registrations',
                required=True,
            )
        ]
    )

    def post(self, request):

        # Look for the special header send by the frontend (or Postman)
        idempotency_key = request.headers.get('Idempotency-Key')

        # If they sent a key, check if we already saved an answer for it
        if not idempotency_key or not check_valid_uuid(idempotency_key):

            return Response({"details": "The Idempotency-Key header is required and must be a valid UUID v4."}, 
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
        
        cached_response = cache.get(idempotency_key)

        if cached_response:
            # They Double Clicked! Give them the cached answer
            return Response(cached_response['data'], status=cached_response['status'])


        # 1. Give the incoming JSON data to our bouncer (the Serializer)
        
        serializer = UserRegistrationSerializer(data=request.data)

        # 2. The bouncer checks if the data matches the blueprint perfeclty

        if serializer.is_valid():

            # 3. If valid, encrpyt the password and save to the database

            user = serializer.save()

            refresh = CustomLoginSerializer.get_token(user)

            response_data = {
                "message": "Account created successfully",
                "access": str(refresh.access_token),
                "refresh": str(refresh)
            }
            response_status = status.HTTP_201_CREATED
            
            # Trap the double-click: Save the answer in the cache for 24 hours
            if idempotency_key:
                cache.set(
                    idempotency_key, 
                    {'data': response_data, 'status': response_status},
                    timeout=86400 # 86400 seconds = 24 hours
                )

            return Response(
                response_data,
                status=response_status
            )
            
        # If invalid (e.g., missing an email), send the exact error back

        return Response(
            serializer.errors,
            status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST
        )
    
    def throttled(self, request, wait):
        seconds = max(1, math.ceil(wait if wait is not None else 300))
        minutes = math.ceil(seconds / 60)
        unit = 'minute' if minutes == 1 else 'minutes'
        message = (
            'No account was created by this attempt. Too many registration attempts. '
            f'Please try again in {minutes} {unit}.'
        )
        error = Throttled(detail=message, code='registration_throttled')
        # Preserve Retry-After without adding DRF's technical seconds suffix.
        error.wait = seconds
        raise error


class LoginThrottle(AnonRateThrottle):
    """
    Implements a Sliding Window rate limit for login attempts.
    This throttle prevents brute-force attacks by limiting the number of 
    failed login attempts an anonymous user can make. It uses a sliding 
    window algorithm rather than a fixed clock, meaning the restriction 
    only lifts when the oldest failed attempt falls out of the time window.
    Attributes:
        rate (str): Set to 'custom' to bypass DRF's default s/m/h/d parser.
    """
    
    rate = 'custom'
    
    def parse_rate(self, rate):
        """
        Overrides the default string parser to enforce exact math.
        
        Returns:
            tuple: (number_of_attempts, cooldown_in_seconds)
                   Currently set to 5 attempts per 300 seconds (5 minutes).
        """
        return (5, 300)

class CustomLoginView(TokenObtainPairView):
    """
    Secure login endpoint utilizing JWT authentication and brute-force protection.
    Inherits from SimpleJWT's TokenObtainPairView to generate Access and 
    Refresh tokens. It applies a custom serializer to format error messages 
    and a rate throttle to lock out abusive traffic.
    Attributes:
        serializer_class (Serializer): Custom serializer for user-friendly 401 errors.
        throttle_classes (list): Applies the LoginThrottle sliding window limit.
    """
    serializer_class = CustomLoginSerializer
    throttle_classes = [LoginThrottle]
    def throttled(self, request, wait):
        """
        Intercepts the default throttle exception to provide a custom UI message.
        Args:
            request (Request): The incoming HTTP request.
            wait (int): The number of seconds remaining before the throttle lifts.
        Raises:
            Throttled: Returns a 429 Too Many Requests with a user-friendly 
                       wait time rounded up to the nearest minute.
        """
        custom_message = f"Too many attempts. Please try again in {math.ceil(wait/60)} minutes."
        raise Throttled(detail=custom_message)

class AdminUserListView(generics.ListAPIView):
    """
    Returns registered users formatted for the Admin User Directory dashboard.
    """
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated, IsPortalAdmin]

    def get(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        role_param = request.query_params.get('role')
        barangay_param = request.query_params.get('barangay')
        manage_access = request.query_params.get('access_management') == '1'

        # Apply the shared saved-profile policy below; never infer jurisdiction from street text.
        from chat.services import can_chat, location_key
        from chat.moderation import may_manage
        is_barangay = request.user.account_type == 'Barangay'
        if is_barangay:
            barangay_param = None

        # Dynamic active LGU barangay set (accounts with account_type='Barangay')
        active_lgus = [
            b.strip() for b in tbl_user_profile.objects.filter(
                account_type='Barangay', is_active=True
            ).exclude(barangay__isnull=True).exclude(barangay__exact='')
            .values_list('barangay', flat=True) if b and b.strip()
        ]
        active_lgus_lower = [b.lower() for b in active_lgus]

        if manage_access:
            users_qs = tbl_user_profile.objects.filter(account_type__in=['Homeowner', 'Kasambahay']).prefetch_related('documents').order_by('first_name', 'last_name', 'pk')
        elif role_param and role_param.upper() in ['BARANGAY', 'ADMIN']:
            users_qs = tbl_user_profile.objects.filter(account_type='Barangay').order_by('barangay')
        elif role_param and role_param.upper() == 'SUPERADMIN':
            users_qs = tbl_user_profile.objects.filter(account_type='Admin').order_by('-date_joined')
        else:
            users_qs = tbl_user_profile.objects.filter(account_type__in=['Homeowner', 'Kasambahay', 'Barangay', 'Admin']).order_by('-date_joined')
            if role_param and role_param.upper() != 'ALL':
                users_qs = users_qs.filter(account_type__iexact=role_param)

        from django.db.models import Q
        if barangay_param and not manage_access:
            if barangay_param.upper() in ['UNASSIGNED', 'NO LGU COVERAGE', 'NO_LGU']:
                # Exclude all users that belong to active LGU barangays
                q_assigned = Q()
                for b in active_lgus:
                    q_assigned |= Q(barangay__iexact=b)
                users_qs = users_qs.exclude(q_assigned)
            elif barangay_param.upper() not in ['ALL', 'ALL BARANGAYS']:
                users_qs = users_qs.filter(
                    Q(account_type='Admin') |
                    Q(barangay__iexact=barangay_param) |
                    Q(city__icontains=barangay_param) |
                    Q(street__icontains=barangay_param)
                )

        users_qs = users_qs.annotate(
            completed_posted_count=Count('user_post', filter=Q(user_post__booking_status='Completed'), distinct=True),
            completed_assigned_count=Count('accepted_bookings__booking_id', filter=Q(accepted_bookings__booking_id__booking_status='Completed'), distinct=True),
            review_count=Count('reviews_received', distinct=True),
            positive_count=Count('reviews_received', filter=Q(reviews_received__nlp_sentiment='Positive'), distinct=True),
            neutral_count=Count('reviews_received', filter=Q(reviews_received__nlp_sentiment='Neutral'), distinct=True),
            negative_count=Count('reviews_received', filter=Q(reviews_received__nlp_sentiment='Negative'), distinct=True),
        )
        data = []
        for u in users_qs:
            if manage_access:
                # Include suspended/deactivated residents for restoration, while enforcing
                # the same strict authority as the suspension mutation endpoint.
                if not may_manage(request.user, u):
                    continue
                if barangay_param and barangay_param.upper() not in ['ALL', 'ALL BARANGAYS']:
                    key = location_key(u.barangay, barangay=True)
                    if barangay_param.upper() in ['UNASSIGNED', 'NO LGU COVERAGE', 'NO_LGU']:
                        covered = {location_key(b, barangay=True) for b in active_lgus}
                        if key and key in covered:
                            continue
                    elif key != location_key(barangay_param, barangay=True):
                        continue
            elif is_barangay and not can_chat(request.user, u):
                continue
            if u.account_type == 'Barangay':
                full_name = f"Brgy. {u.barangay} Officer" if u.barangay else (f"{u.first_name} {u.last_name}".strip() or u.username)
                role_norm = 'BARANGAY'
            elif u.account_type == 'Admin':
                full_name = f"{u.first_name} {u.last_name}".strip() or "City Super Admin"
                role_norm = 'SUPERADMIN'
            elif u.account_type == 'Kasambahay':
                full_name = f"{u.first_name} {u.last_name}".strip() or u.username
                role_norm = 'KASAMBAHAY'
            else:
                full_name = f"{u.first_name} {u.last_name}".strip() or u.username
                role_norm = 'HOMEOWNER'

            avatar = (
                get_signed_cloudinary_url(u.profile_link, as_avatar=True)
                or f"https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name={u.first_name}+{u.last_name}&background=F5A623&color=fff"
            )
            is_verified = (u.verification_status == 'Verified') or (u.account_type in ['Barangay', 'Admin'])

            brgy = (u.barangay or '').strip()
            if not brgy and not manage_access:
                street_lower = (u.street or '').lower()
                city_lower = (u.city or '').lower()
                for b in active_lgus:
                    if b.lower() in street_lower or b.lower() in city_lower:
                        brgy = b
                        break
            if not brgy:
                brgy = 'Unassigned'

            has_lgu_coverage = bool(brgy and brgy.lower() in active_lgus_lower)

            user_item = {
                "id": str(u.id),
                "name": full_name,
                "role": role_norm,
                "avatar": avatar,
                "email": u.email,
                "contactNumber": u.contact_number or "",
                "address": ', '.join(part for part in [u.street, u.city] if part),
                "barangay": brgy,
                "city": u.city or "",
                "verified": is_verified,
                "hasLguCoverage": has_lgu_coverage,
                "status": "ACTIVE" if u.is_active and not u.is_account_suspended else "SUSPENDED",
                "canManageSuspension": may_manage(request.user, u),
                "joinedDate": u.date_joined.strftime('%b %d, %Y') if u.date_joined else "Recent",
                "completedJobs": u.completed_posted_count + u.completed_assigned_count,
                "sentimentScore": {
                    "positive": round(u.positive_count * 100 / u.review_count) if u.review_count else 0,
                    "neutral": round(u.neutral_count * 100 / u.review_count) if u.review_count else 0,
                    "negative": round(u.negative_count * 100 / u.review_count) if u.review_count else 0,
                },
                "ra10361Compliant": None,
            }
            if manage_access:
                user_item.update({
                    'chatSuspendedUntil': u.chat_suspended_until.isoformat() if u.chat_suspended_until else None,
                    'isAccountSuspended': u.is_account_suspended,
                    'isAccountActive': u.is_active,
                })
            social_links_raw = getattr(u, 'social_links', []) or []
            show_links = getattr(u, 'show_social_links', True)
            user_item["socialLinks"] = social_links_raw if show_links else []
            data.append(user_item)

        response = Response(data, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)
        if manage_access:
            response['Cache-Control'] = 'private, no-store'
        return response

class AdminDashboardActivityView(APIView):
    """
    Returns recent booking placements for the admin dashboard activity table.
    Queries real tbl_booking + tbl_booking_assignment records, scoped optionally by barangay.
    Returns the latest 10 accepted/in-progress/completed bookings.
    """
    permission_classes = [AllowAny]

    def get(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        barangay_param = request.query_params.get('barangay')
        from booking.models import tbl_booking, tbl_booking_assignment
        from django.db.models import Q

        # Get bookings ordered by most recent first
        bookings_qs = tbl_booking.objects.select_related('poster_id').order_by('-createdAt')

        # Optional barangay scope
        if barangay_param and barangay_param.upper() not in ['ALL', 'ALL BARANGAYS']:
            bookings_qs = bookings_qs.filter(
                Q(barangay__iexact=barangay_param) |
                Q(barangay__icontains=barangay_param) |
                Q(poster_id__barangay__iexact=barangay_param) |
                Q(poster_id__barangay__icontains=barangay_param) |
                Q(poster_id__city__icontains=barangay_param) |
                Q(poster_id__street__icontains=barangay_param)
            )

        result = []
        for booking in bookings_qs[:100]:
            poster = booking.poster_id
            poster_name = f"{poster.first_name} {poster.last_name}".strip() or poster.username
            poster_role = (getattr(poster, 'account_type', '') or '').strip()

            # Build avatar URL for poster (Optimized WebP)
            poster_avatar = (
                get_signed_cloudinary_url(poster.profile_link, as_avatar=True)
                or f"https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name={poster.first_name}+{poster.last_name}&background=F5A623&color=fff"
            )

            # Try to find assigned counterpart
            assignment = tbl_booking_assignment.objects.filter(booking_id=booking).select_related('accepter_id').first()
            accepter_name = None
            accepter_avatar = None
            if assignment and assignment.accepter_id:
                w = assignment.accepter_id
                accepter_name = f"{w.first_name} {w.last_name}".strip() or w.username
                accepter_avatar = (
                    get_signed_cloudinary_url(w.profile_link, as_avatar=True)
                    or f"https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name={w.first_name}+{w.last_name}&background=0D0D11&color=fff"
                )

            unassigned_avatar = 'https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=?&background=E2E8F0&color=94A3B8'

            # Role-aware assignment:
            # If poster is Kasambahay (offering services / looking for job), Kasambahay is the worker.
            # The Employer is the counterpart who hired/accepted them (or 'Unassigned').
            if poster_role.lower() == 'kasambahay':
                worker_name = poster_name
                worker_avatar = poster_avatar
                homeowner_name = accepter_name or 'Unassigned'
                homeowner_avatar = accepter_avatar or unassigned_avatar
            else:
                # Homeowner posted the job request, Kasambahay is the counterpart (or 'Unassigned')
                homeowner_name = poster_name
                homeowner_avatar = poster_avatar
                worker_name = accepter_name or 'Unassigned'
                worker_avatar = accepter_avatar or unassigned_avatar

            from booking.wage_policy import get_minimum_wage_info
            from booking.services import pair_booking_count
            from rest_framework.exceptions import ValidationError
            try:
                policy = get_minimum_wage_info(booking.booking_type, booking.full_address, booking.region)
                minimum = float(policy['minimum_rate'])
            except ValidationError:
                minimum = None
            amount = float(booking.rate_amount)
            needs_review = booking.rate_needs_review or minimum is None
            is_below_min = minimum is not None and amount < minimum
            short_term_count = pair_booking_count(poster.pk, assignment.accepter_id_id, booking.start_time) if assignment else 0
            is_capped = short_term_count >= 3
            if needs_review:
                compliance_status = 'REQUIRES_REVIEW'
            elif is_below_min:
                compliance_status = 'BELOW_MINIMUM_WAGE'
            elif short_term_count > 3 and booking.booking_type == 'short_term':
                compliance_status = 'FLAGGED_THROTTLED'
            else:
                compliance_status = 'COMPLIANT'

            # Contract type label
            contract_type = 'Formal Kasambahay (Long-Term)' if booking.booking_type == 'long_term' else 'Short-Term On-Demand'

            # Barangay
            brgy = booking.barangay or poster.barangay or ''
            if not brgy:
                for b_name in ['Pagatpat', 'Canitoan']:
                    if b_name.lower() in (poster.street or '').lower() or b_name.lower() in (poster.city or '').lower() or b_name.lower() in (booking.street or '').lower() or b_name.lower() in (booking.full_address or '').lower():
                        brgy = b_name
                        break
            if not brgy:
                brgy = 'Unknown'

            result.append({
                'id': str(booking.booking_id),
                'homeownerName': homeowner_name,
                'homeownerAvatar': homeowner_avatar,
                'workerName': worker_name,
                'workerAvatar': worker_avatar,
                'serviceCategory': ', '.join(booking.service_category),
                'monthlyBookingsCount': short_term_count,
                'isCapped': is_capped,
                'offeredWage': amount,
                'ratePeriod': booking.rate_period,
                'pairKey': ':'.join(sorted([str(poster.pk), str(assignment.accepter_id_id)])) if assignment else None,
                'rateNeedsReview': needs_review,
                'dailyRate': amount if booking.rate_period == 'day' else None,
                'minimumWageBaseline': minimum,
                'isBelowMinimumWage': is_below_min,
                'contractType': contract_type,
                'bookingType': booking.booking_type,
                'bookingStatus': booking.booking_status,
                'startDate': booking.start_time.strftime('%b %d, %Y') if booking.start_time else 'TBD',
                'status': compliance_status,
                'barangay': brgy,
                'createdAt': booking.createdAt.isoformat() if booking.createdAt else None,
            })

        return Response({'bookings': result, 'count': len(result)}, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)
