class AdminLoginView(APIView):
    """
    Dedicated authentication endpoint for Web Admin Portal (Superadmin and Barangay LGU officers).
    Allows any user with account_type in ['Admin', 'Barangay'] or is_staff/is_superuser to log in.
    Returns their profile, role, and assigned barangay.
    """
    permission_classes = [AllowAny]

    def post(self, request):
        raw_identifier = (request.data.get('username') or request.data.get('email') or '').strip()

        password = (request.data.get('password') or '').strip()

        if not raw_identifier or not password:
            return Response({'error': 'Please provide both username/email and password.'}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        from django.db.models import Q
        user = tbl_user_profile.objects.filter(
            Q(email__iexact=raw_identifier) | Q(username__iexact=raw_identifier)
        ).first()

        if user is None or not user.check_password(password):
            return Response({'error': 'Invalid credentials. Please check your username and password.'}, status=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED)

        if not user.is_active:
            return Response({'error': 'This administrative account has been deactivated.'}, status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN)

        from .authentication import assert_account_available
        assert_account_available(user)

        if user.account_type == 'Barangay':
            # Guard: LGU account must have a barangay assigned or login is blocked
            if not user.barangay or not user.barangay.strip():
                return Response(
                    {'error': 'Your LGU account is not assigned to a barangay. Please contact the Superadmin to fix your account.'},
                    status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN
                )
            role = 'ADMIN'
            barangay = user.barangay.strip().title()
        elif user.account_type == 'Admin' or user.is_superuser or user.is_staff:
            role = 'SUPERADMIN'
            barangay = 'All Barangays'
        else:
            return Response({'error': 'Access denied. Only Superadmins and Barangay Officers can access this portal.'}, status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN)

        from rest_framework_simplejwt.tokens import RefreshToken
        refresh = RefreshToken.for_user(user)

        avatar = (
            get_signed_cloudinary_url(user.profile_link, as_avatar=True)
            or f"https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name={user.first_name}+{user.last_name}&background=0D0D11&color=fff"
        )

        return Response({
            'success': True,
            'token': str(refresh.access_token),
            'refresh': str(refresh),
            'user': {
                'id': str(user.id),
                'username': user.username,
                'name': f"{user.first_name} {user.last_name}".strip() or user.username,
                'email': user.email,
                'role': role,
                'barangay': barangay,
                'avatar': avatar,
            }
        }, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)


class AdminActiveBarangaysView(APIView):
    """Real LGU accounts and registered resident locations, with no seeded jurisdictions."""
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated, IsPortalAdmin]

    def get_permissions(self):
        classes = [IsAuthenticated, IsPortalSuperadmin] if self.request.method == 'POST' else self.permission_classes
        return [permission() for permission in classes]

    def get(self, request):
        from .admin_statistics import resident_snapshot, scope_for
        rows = resident_snapshot(scope_for(request), restrict_directory=request.user.account_type == 'Barangay')['barangays']
        active = [row['name'] for row in rows if row['status'] == 'ACTIVE']
        response = Response({'barangays': active, 'active_lgus': active,
                             'user_barangays': [row['name'] for row in rows]})
        response['Cache-Control'] = 'private, no-store'
        return response

    def post(self, request):
        """
        Registers a new official administrative Barangay LGU jurisdiction in the database.
        Creates an active Barangay user account in tbl_user_profile, ensuring strict persistence.
        """
        data = request.data
        raw_name = data.get('name') or data.get('barangay')
        if not raw_name or not str(raw_name).strip():
            return Response({'error': 'Barangay name is required.'}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        clean_b = re.sub(r'^(brgy\.?|barangay)\s+', '', str(raw_name), flags=re.IGNORECASE).strip().title()

        # Check for duplicate Barangay account
        existing = tbl_user_profile.objects.filter(
            account_type='Barangay',
            is_active=True
        )
        for ex in existing:
            ex_clean = re.sub(r'^(brgy\.?|barangay)\s+', '', ex.barangay or '', flags=re.IGNORECASE).strip().lower()
            if ex_clean == clean_b.lower():
                return Response(
                    {'error': f"An official LGU account for Barangay {clean_b} is already registered in the directory."},
                    status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST
                )

        slug = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]', '', clean_b.lower())
        email = data.get('email') or f"{slug}@lgu.serbisure.ph"
        if tbl_user_profile.objects.filter(email=email).exists():
            import uuid
            email = f"{slug}_{str(uuid.uuid4())[:4]}@lgu.serbisure.ph"

        contact_number = (data.get('contact_number') or '').strip()
        if not contact_number:
            return Response({'error': 'An actual desk contact number is required.'}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
        if contact_number:
            clean_digits = re.sub(r'\D', '', contact_number)
            if clean_digits.startswith('639') and len(clean_digits) == 12:
                contact_number = f"+{clean_digits}"
            elif clean_digits.startswith('09') and len(clean_digits) == 11:
                contact_number = f"+63{clean_digits[1:]}"
            elif clean_digits.startswith('9') and len(clean_digits) == 10:
                contact_number = f"+63{clean_digits}"
            else:
                return Response(
                    {'error': "Please enter a valid 10-digit mobile number starting with 9 (e.g. 917 123 4567)."},
                    status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST
                )

            # Check if this contact number is already registered in the system
            if tbl_user_profile.objects.filter(contact_number=contact_number).exists():
                display_num = f"+63 {contact_number[3:6]} {contact_number[6:9]} {contact_number[9:]}" if len(contact_number) == 13 else contact_number
                return Response(
                    {'error': f"The contact number {display_num} is already registered to another account. Please use a different hotline number."},
                    status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST
                )

        try:
            user = tbl_user_profile(
                username=f"lgu_{slug}",
                email=email,
                first_name=clean_b,
                last_name="Desk",
                account_type="Barangay",
                barangay=clean_b,
                region=data.get('region') or '',
                province=data.get('province') or '',
                city=data.get('city') or '',
                street=data.get('street') or '',
                zipcode=data.get('zipcode') or '',
                country=data.get('country') or '',
                contact_number=contact_number,
                is_active=True,
                is_staff=True,
            )
            user.set_password(data.get('password') or 'Lgu@12345')
            user.save()
        except IntegrityError as e:
            err_str = str(e).lower()
            if 'contact_number' in err_str:
                display_num = f"+63 {contact_number[3:6]} {contact_number[6:9]} {contact_number[9:]}" if len(contact_number) == 13 else contact_number
                error_msg = f"The contact number {display_num} is already registered to another account. Please use a different hotline number."
            elif 'unique_lgu_account_per_barangay' in err_str:
                error_msg = f"Barangay {clean_b} is already registered in the directory. Each barangay can only have one official account."
            elif 'email' in err_str:
                error_msg = f"The email address '{email}' is already in use by another account. Please use a different email."
            elif 'username' in err_str:
                error_msg = f"The username 'lgu_{slug}' is already taken. Please try again."
            else:
                error_msg = f"Barangay {clean_b} could not be registered because an account with matching details already exists."
            return Response(
                {'error': error_msg},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST
            )
        except Exception:
            return Response(
                {'error': f"Unable to register Barangay {clean_b}. Please verify the form details and try again."},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST
            )

        return Response({
            'success': True,
            'message': f"Barangay {clean_b} successfully registered in the database.",
            'barangay': {
                'name': clean_b,
                'email': user.email,
                'barangay': clean_b,
                'city': user.city,
                'province': user.province,
                'region': user.region,
                'zipcode': user.zipcode,
                'country': user.country,
                'status': 'ACTIVE',
            }
        }, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)


class ProfileImageUploadThrottle(UserRateThrottle):
    scope = 'profile_image_upload'
    rate = '2/h'

class ProfileImageUploadView(generics.UpdateAPIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]
    parser_classes = (MultiPartParser, FormParser)
    serializer_class = ProfileImageUploadSerializer
    throttle_classes = [ProfileImageUploadThrottle]

    def perform_update(self, serializer):
        super().perform_update(serializer)
        self.upload_timings = serializer.context.get('upload_timings', {})

    def update(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        from time import perf_counter
        from verifications.services.profile_photos import check_photo_upload
        check_photo_upload(request.user)
        started_at = perf_counter()
        response = super().update(request, *args, **kwargs)
        timings = {**getattr(self, 'upload_timings', {}), 'profile_request': (perf_counter() - started_at) * 1000}
        response['Server-Timing'] = ', '.join(f'{name};dur={duration:.1f}' for name, duration in timings.items())
        return response

    def get_object(self):
        # We automatically return the logged-in user!
        return self.request.user

    def throttled(self, request, wait):        
    # 3600 seconds = 1 hour
        if wait > 3600: 
            time_left = math.ceil(wait / 3600)
            custom_message = f"Too many attempts. Please try again in {time_left} hours."

        else:
            custom_message = f"Too many attempts. Please try again in {math.ceil(wait/60)} minutes."

        raise Throttled(detail=custom_message)

class ChangePasswordView(APIView):
    """
    Endpoint allowing authenticated users to change their password.
    Requires current_password, new_password, and confirm_password.
    """
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request):
        current_password = request.data.get('current_password')
        new_password = request.data.get('new_password')
        confirm_password = request.data.get('confirm_password')

        if not current_password or not new_password or not confirm_password:
            return Response(
                {'error': 'Current password, new password, and confirmation are required.'},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST
            )

        if new_password != confirm_password:
            return Response({'error': 'New passwords do not match.'}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        if len(new_password) < 8:
            return Response({'error': 'Password must be at least 8 characters long.'}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        if not request.user.check_password(current_password):
            return Response({'error': 'Current password is incorrect.'}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        if current_password == new_password:
            return Response({'error': 'New password must be different from current password.'}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        request.user.set_password(new_password)
        request.user.save()
        return Response({'message': 'Password changed successfully.'}, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)


class UserSearchView(APIView):
    """
    Search active users by query keyword, account type (Kasambahay / Homeowner),
    city, province, or tags (Tier 2-2).
    """
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        query = request.query_params.get('q', '').strip()
        role = request.query_params.get('role', '').strip()
        location = request.query_params.get('location', '').strip()
        tag = request.query_params.get('tag', '').strip()

        qs = tbl_user_profile.objects.filter(is_active=True).exclude(id=request.user.id)

        if role:
            qs = qs.filter(account_type__iexact=role)
        
        if location:
            qs = qs.filter(Q(city__icontains=location) | Q(province__icontains=location) | Q(street__icontains=location))

        if tag:
            qs = qs.filter(user_tags__icontains=tag)

        if query:
            qs = qs.filter(
                Q(first_name__icontains=query) |
                Q(last_name__icontains=query) |
                Q(user_about__icontains=query) |
                Q(city__icontains=query) |
                Q(user_tags__icontains=query)
            )

        serializer = PublicProfileSerializer(qs[:30], many=True)
        return Response({'users': serializer.data, 'count': qs.count()}, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)


class DeleteAccountView(APIView):
    """
    Soft-deletes and deactivates the authenticated user's account (Tier 3-5).
    Requires the current password to confirm the critical operation.
    """
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request):
        password = request.data.get('password')
        if not password:
            return Response({'error': 'Password is required to confirm account deletion.'}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        if not request.user.check_password(password):
            return Response({'error': 'Incorrect password.'}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        user = request.user
        user.is_active = False
        user.user_about = '[Account Deactivated]'
        # Anonymize contact number collision-free using user.id hash while respecting ^\+639\d{9}$
        unique_suffix = f"{int(user.id.hex[:8], 16) % 900000000 + 100000000}"
        user.contact_number = f"+639{unique_suffix}"
        user.user_tags = []
        user.save()

        return Response({'message': 'Your account has been deactivated successfully.'}, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)


class ExportUserDataView(APIView):
    """
    Exports a GDPR-style archive of the user's personal data (Tier 3-5).
    """
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        user = request.user
        from booking.models import tbl_booking, tbl_booking_assignment
        from reviews.models import tbl_review

        posted_bookings = list(tbl_booking.objects.filter(poster_id=user).values(
            'booking_id', 'booking_type', 'booking_status', 'service_category', 'rate_amount', 'rate_period', 'rate_needs_review',
            'street', 'barangay', 'city', 'province', 'region', 'zip_code', 'createdAt'
        ))
        for b in posted_bookings:
            b['booking_id'] = str(b['booking_id'])
            b['createdAt'] = str(b['createdAt'])
            b['rate_amount'] = str(b['rate_amount'])
            addr_parts = [b.get(k) for k in ['street', 'barangay', 'city', 'province'] if b.get(k)]
            b['full_address'] = ', '.join(addr_parts) if addr_parts else ''

        assigned_bookings = list(tbl_booking_assignment.objects.filter(accepter_id=user).values(
            'booking_assignment_id', 'booking_id', 'accepted_at'
        ))
        for a in assigned_bookings:
            a['booking_assignment_id'] = str(a['booking_assignment_id'])
            a['booking_id'] = str(a['booking_id'])
            a['accepted_at'] = str(a['accepted_at'])

        reviews_given = list(tbl_review.objects.filter(reviewer_id=user).values(
            'review_id', 'rating', 'unstructured_feedback', 'nlp_sentiment', 'createdAt'
        ))
        for r in reviews_given:
            r['review_id'] = str(r['review_id'])
            r['createdAt'] = str(r['createdAt'])

        reviews_received = list(tbl_review.objects.filter(reviewee_id=user).values(
            'review_id', 'rating', 'unstructured_feedback', 'nlp_sentiment', 'createdAt'
        ))
        for r in reviews_received:
            r['review_id'] = str(r['review_id'])
            r['createdAt'] = str(r['createdAt'])

        data = {
            'profile': {
                'id': str(user.id),
                'email': user.email,
                'first_name': user.first_name,
                'middle_name': user.middle_name,
                'last_name': user.last_name,
                'account_type': user.account_type,
                'verification_status': user.verification_status,
                'contact_number': user.contact_number,
                'user_about': user.user_about,
                'user_tags': user.user_tags,
                'city': user.city,
                'province': user.province,
                'date_joined': str(user.date_joined),
            },
            'posted_bookings': posted_bookings,
            'assigned_bookings': assigned_bookings,
            'reviews_given': reviews_given,
            'reviews_received': reviews_received,
        }

        return Response({'user_data': data}, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)


class AdminBarangayDeskProfileView(APIView):
    """
    Dedicated endpoint for Barangay Desk Profile in the Admin Portal.
    Allows authenticated LGU officers (or Superadmins) to view and update
    the desk information stored across existing tbl_user_profile columns:
    - barangay: user's barangay name
    - street: desk / barangay hall physical address
    - contact_number: official desk hotline
    - user_about: desk operating hours & public information
    - first_name & last_name: desk officer-in-charge
    - email: desk official email
    """
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        user = request.user
        barangay_param = request.query_params.get('barangay')

        # If Superadmin specifies ?barangay=..., look up that LGU officer
        if user.account_type in ['Admin'] or user.is_staff or user.is_superuser:
            if barangay_param and barangay_param.lower() not in ['all', 'all barangays']:
                target_user = tbl_user_profile.objects.filter(
                    account_type='Barangay',
                    barangay__iexact=barangay_param.strip()
                ).first()
                if target_user:
                    user = target_user

        officer_name = f"{user.first_name} {user.last_name}".strip()

        return Response({
            'success': True,
            'barangay': user.barangay or '',
            'street': user.street or '',
            'contact_number': user.contact_number or '',
            'user_about': user.user_about or '',
            'first_name': user.first_name or '',
            'last_name': user.last_name or '',
            'officer_name': officer_name,
            'email': user.email or '',
            'city': user.city or '',
            'province': user.province or '',
            'zipcode': user.zipcode or '',
        }, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)

    def put(self, request):
        return self.patch(request)

    def patch(self, request):
        user = request.user
        barangay_param = request.data.get('barangay')

        # Allow Superadmin to update a specific barangay's officer profile
        if (user.account_type in ['Admin'] or user.is_staff or user.is_superuser) and barangay_param:
            target_user = tbl_user_profile.objects.filter(
                account_type='Barangay',
                barangay__iexact=barangay_param.strip()
            ).first()
            if target_user:
                user = target_user

        data = request.data
        update_fields = []

        # 1. Street (Address)
        if 'street' in data:
            street_val = (data.get('street') or '').strip()
            if len(street_val) > 100:
                return Response({'error': 'Address cannot exceed 100 characters.'}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
            user.street = street_val
            update_fields.append('street')

        # 2. Contact Number (Hotline)
        if 'contact_number' in data:
            raw_contact = (data.get('contact_number') or '').strip()
            if raw_contact:
                normalized = normalize_ph_phone_number(raw_contact)
                if not normalized or len(normalized) != 13 or not normalized.startswith('+639'):
                    return Response({'error': "Hotline must be a valid PH mobile number starting with '+639' (e.g., +639123456789)."}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
                # Check uniqueness against other users
                conflict = tbl_user_profile.objects.filter(contact_number=normalized).exclude(id=user.id).exists()
                if conflict:
                    return Response({'error': 'This contact number is already registered by another account.'}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
                user.contact_number = normalized
                update_fields.append('contact_number')

        # 3. User About (Office Hours & Desk Info)
        if 'user_about' in data:
            about_val = (data.get('user_about') or '').strip()
            if len(about_val) > 500:
                return Response({'error': 'Office hours & desk info cannot exceed 500 characters.'}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
            user.user_about = about_val
            update_fields.append('user_about')

        # 4. Officer First Name & Last Name
        if 'first_name' in data:
            fn_val = (data.get('first_name') or '').strip()
            if fn_val:
                user.first_name = fn_val[:100]
                update_fields.append('first_name')

        if 'last_name' in data:
            ln_val = (data.get('last_name') or '').strip()
            if ln_val:
                user.last_name = ln_val[:100]
                update_fields.append('last_name')

        if update_fields:
            user.save(update_fields=list(set(update_fields)))

        officer_name = f"{user.first_name} {user.last_name}".strip()

        return Response({
            'success': True,
            'message': 'Barangay desk profile updated successfully.',
            'profile': {
                'barangay': user.barangay or '',
                'street': user.street or '',
                'contact_number': user.contact_number or '',
                'user_about': user.user_about or '',
                'first_name': user.first_name or '',
                'last_name': user.last_name or '',
                'officer_name': officer_name,
                'email': user.email or '',

from django.http import HttpResponse
from django.db import transaction
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.throttling import UserRateThrottle
from .models import tbl_user_profile, tbl_worker_profile
from .permissions import IsKasambahay
from .worker_serializers import WorkerProfileSerializer
from .cv_service import snapshot, pdf_bytes, csv_bytes


class CvThrottle(UserRateThrottle):
    scope = 'worker_cv'
    rate = '30/h'


class WorkerProfileView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated, IsKasambahay]

    def get(self, request):
        instance = tbl_worker_profile.objects.filter(user=request.user).first()
        response = Response({**WorkerProfileSerializer(instance or tbl_worker_profile(user=request.user)).data,
                             'languages': [value.strip() for value in (request.user.language or '').split(',') if value.strip()]})
        response['Cache-Control'] = 'private, no-store'
        return response

    def patch(self, request):
        with transaction.atomic():
            user = tbl_user_profile.objects.select_for_update().get(pk=request.user.pk)
            instance, _ = tbl_worker_profile.objects.get_or_create(user=user)
            serializer = WorkerProfileSerializer(instance, data=request.data, partial=True)
            serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
            instance = serializer.save()
            labels = {'Child_care': 'Child Care'}
            tags = user.user_tags or []
            fields = []
            if 'service_categories' in request.data:
                category_tags = {'Cleaning', 'Cooking', 'Cook', 'Laundry', 'Child Care', 'Childcare', 'Child_care', 'Caregiver', 'All-around'}
                tags = [labels.get(value, value) for value in instance.service_categories] + [tag for tag in tags if tag not in category_tags]
            if 'work_setup' in request.data:
                tags = [tag for tag in tags if tag not in {'Stay-In', 'Stay-Out', 'Either'}]
                setup = {'stay_in': 'Stay-In', 'stay_out': 'Stay-Out', 'either': 'Either'}.get(instance.work_setup)
                if setup:
                    tags.append(setup)
            if 'service_categories' in request.data or 'work_setup' in request.data:
                user.user_tags = tags[:10]
                fields.append('user_tags')
            if 'languages' in request.data:
                # Language choices are validated separately; all profile writes stay atomic.
                from rest_framework import serializers
                values = serializers.ListField(child=serializers.ChoiceField(choices=['Bisaya', 'Tagalog', 'English']), max_length=3).run_validation(request.data['languages'])
                user.language = ', '.join(dict.fromkeys(values))
                fields.append('language')
            if fields:
                user.save(update_fields=fields)
        return Response({**WorkerProfileSerializer(instance).data,
                         'languages': [value.strip() for value in (user.language or '').split(',') if value.strip()]})


class WorkerCvView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]
    throttle_classes = [CvThrottle]

    def get(self, request, user_id):
        worker = get_object_or_404(tbl_user_profile, pk=user_id, account_type='Kasambahay', is_active=True)
        response = Response(snapshot(worker))
        response['Cache-Control'] = 'private, no-store'
        return response


class WorkerCvExportView(WorkerCvView):
    def get(self, request, user_id):
        worker = get_object_or_404(tbl_user_profile, pk=user_id, account_type='Kasambahay', is_active=True)
        file_format = request.query_params.get('file_format', 'pdf')
        if file_format not in ('pdf', 'csv'):
            return Response({'detail': 'Choose PDF or CSV.'}, status=400)
        if file_format == 'csv' and worker.pk != request.user.pk:
            return Response({'detail': 'Only the worker can export their CSV.'}, status=403)
        data = snapshot(worker)
        content = pdf_bytes(data) if file_format == 'pdf' else csv_bytes(data)
        mime = 'application/pdf' if file_format == 'pdf' else 'text/csv; charset=utf-8'
        response = HttpResponse(content, content_type=mime)
        response['Content-Disposition'] = f'attachment; filename="SerbiSure_CV.{file_format}"'
        response['Cache-Control'] = 'private, no-store'
        response['X-Content-Type-Options'] = 'nosniff'
        return response

"""One cancellation policy for both roles and both engagement types."""
from datetime import timedelta
from django.db import transaction
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from django.utils import timezone
from rest_framework.exceptions import PermissionDenied, ValidationError
from accounts.penalties import penalty_status, refresh_monthly_penalties
from .models import tbl_booking
from .services import lock_participants

SAFETY_REASON = 'Safety / Inappropriate Homeowner Behavior'
HOMEOWNER_REASONS = ['Change of household plans', 'Emergency', 'Worker unresponsive', 'Other']
WORKER_REASONS = ['Sickness / Medical', 'Family emergency', 'Transportation / Weather', SAFETY_REASON, 'Other']


def cancellation_reasons(user):
    return WORKER_REASONS if user.account_type == 'Kasambahay' else HOMEOWNER_REASONS


def cancellation_points(booking, at=None):
    if booking.booking_status == 'Pending':
        return 0
    remaining = booking.start_time - (at or timezone.now())
    return 2 if remaining <= timedelta(0) else 1 if remaining < timedelta(hours=24) else 0


def assert_cancellation_access(booking, actor):
    assignment = booking.assignments.first()
    if actor.pk not in (booking.poster_id_id, assignment.accepter_id_id if assignment else None,
                         booking.recipient_id_id if booking.booking_status == 'Pending' else None,
                         booking.cancelled_by_id if booking.booking_status == 'Cancelled' else None):
        raise PermissionDenied('You cannot cancel this booking.')
    if booking.booking_status == 'Completed':
        raise ValidationError({'detail': 'Completed bookings cannot be cancelled.'})
    return assignment


def cancellation_preview(booking, actor):
    assert_cancellation_access(booking, actor)
    if booking.booking_status == 'Cancelled':
        raise ValidationError({'detail': 'This booking is already cancelled.'})
    return {**penalty_status(actor), 'points_to_add': cancellation_points(booking),
            'reasons': cancellation_reasons(actor)}


@transaction.atomic
def cancel_booking(booking_id, actor, reason, expected_points=None, *, pending_only=False):
    preview = get_object_or_404(tbl_booking, pk=booking_id)
    people = lock_participants(preview.poster_id_id, actor.pk)
    actor = people[actor.pk]
    booking = get_object_or_404(tbl_booking.objects.select_for_update(), pk=booking_id)
    assignment = assert_cancellation_access(booking, actor)
    if booking.booking_status == 'Cancelled':
        if booking.cancelled_by_id == actor.pk:
            return booking, actor, False
        raise ValidationError({'detail': 'This booking is already cancelled.'})
    if pending_only and (booking.booking_status != 'Pending' or booking.recipient_id_id or actor.pk != booking.poster_id_id):
        raise ValidationError({'detail': 'This post has already been booked. Refresh your posts to see its current status.'})
    if reason not in cancellation_reasons(actor):
        raise ValidationError({'reason': 'Choose a cancellation reason.'})
    refresh_monthly_penalties(actor)
    points = cancellation_points(booking)
    if expected_points is not None and expected_points != points:
        raise ValidationError({'detail': 'Cancellation timing changed. Review the penalty and try again.'})
    actor.penalty_points = min(3, max(0, actor.penalty_points) + points)
    if actor.penalty_points >= 3:
        actor.is_restricted = True
    actor.save(update_fields=['penalty_points', 'is_restricted'])
    booking.booking_status = 'Cancelled'
    booking.cancellation_reason = reason
    booking.cancelled_by = actor
    booking.cancelled_at = timezone.now()
    booking.cancellation_penalty_points = points
    booking.save(update_fields=['booking_status', 'cancellation_reason', 'cancelled_by', 'cancelled_at', 'cancellation_penalty_points'])
    booking.proposals.filter(status='Pending').update(status='Rejected')
    if assignment:
        from notifications.services import send_in_app_notification
        partner = assignment.accepter_id if actor.pk == booking.poster_id_id else booking.poster_id
        send_in_app_notification(receiver=partner, sender=actor, message='Your booking was cancelled. Open your booking history for details.')
    return booking, actor, True

"""Persist a bilateral offer and its chat reference in one transaction."""
import hashlib
import json
from uuid import UUID
from django.db import transaction
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from rest_framework.exceptions import ValidationError
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.throttling import UserRateThrottle
from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from chat.moderation import LANGUAGE_NOTICE
from .models import tbl_booking
from .serializers import BookingSerializer, BookingDetailSerializer, ChatOfferContextSerializer
from .services import lock_participants, ensure_eligible_pair, enforce_pair_cap


class ChatOfferThrottle(UserRateThrottle):
    scope = 'chat_offer'
    rate = '50/d'


class ChatBookingOfferView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]
    throttle_classes = [ChatOfferThrottle]

    @transaction.atomic
    def post(self, request):
        try:
            key = UUID(request.headers.get('Idempotency-Key', ''))
        except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):
            raise ValidationError({'detail': 'The offer request key is invalid. Reopen the offer and try again.'})
        context = ChatOfferContextSerializer(data=request.data)
        context.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        recipient_id = context.validated_data['recipient_id']
        recipient = get_object_or_404(get_user_model(), pk=recipient_id)
        people = lock_participants(request.user.pk, recipient.pk)
        sender, recipient = people[request.user.pk], people[recipient.pk]
        from chat.moderation import inspect_outgoing
        original_instruction = str(request.data.get('special_instruction') or '')
        instruction = inspect_outgoing(sender, recipient, original_instruction, channel='booking_offer')
        ensure_eligible_pair(sender, recipient)
        digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(request.data, sort_keys=True, default=str).encode()).hexdigest()
        from chat.models import tbl_chat_message
        from chat.serializers import ChatMessageSerializer
        existing = tbl_booking.objects.filter(poster_id=sender, offer_request_key=key).first()
        if existing:
            if existing.offer_payload_hash != digest:
                raise ValidationError({'detail': 'This request key has already been used for different offer terms.'})
            message = existing.chat_messages.get(is_booking_offer=True, booking_proposal__isnull=True)
            return Response({'booking': BookingDetailSerializer(existing, context={'request': request}).data,
                             'chat_message': ChatMessageSerializer(message, context={'request': request}).data,
                             'language_warning': LANGUAGE_NOTICE if instruction != original_instruction else None})
        serializer = BookingSerializer(data=request.data, context={'request': request})
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        required_terms = ['work_days', 'daily_start_time', 'daily_end_time', 'region', 'street']
        if serializer.validated_data['booking_type'] == 'short_term':
            required_terms.append('end_time')
        for field in required_terms:
            if not serializer.validated_data.get(field):
                raise ValidationError({field: 'Specify this agreed term before sending an offer.'})
        booking = serializer.save(poster_id=sender, recipient_id=recipient, special_instruction=instruction,
                                  offer_request_key=key, offer_payload_hash=digest)
        enforce_pair_cap(booking, recipient)
        message = tbl_chat_message.objects.create(sender_id=sender, receiver_id=recipient,
            booking_id=booking, is_booking_offer=True, message_payload='Booking offer: review the agreed terms before accepting.')
        return Response({'booking': BookingDetailSerializer(booking, context={'request': request}).data,
                         'chat_message': ChatMessageSerializer(message, context={'request': request}).data,
                         'language_warning': LANGUAGE_NOTICE if instruction != original_instruction else None}, status=201)

from django.db import models
from django.conf import settings
from django.db.models import CheckConstraint, Q, F
from django.core.validators import RegexValidator, MinValueValidator
from decimal import Decimal
from django.contrib.postgres.fields import ArrayField
import uuid 
import re

# Create your models here.

class tbl_booking(models.Model):

    SERVICES_OFFER_CHOICES = (
        ('Cleaning', 'Cleaning'),
        ('Child_care', 'Child Care'),
        ('Cooking', 'Cooking'),
        ('Caregiver','Caregiver'),
        ('Laundry', 'Laundry'),
        ('All-around', 'All around')
    )

    BOOKING_TYPE_CHOICES = (
        ('short_term', 'Short Term'),
        ('long_term', 'Long Term')
    )

    WORK_SETUP_CHOICES = (('stay_in', 'Stay-in'), ('stay_out', 'Stay-out'))

    BOOKING_STATUS_CHOICES = (
        ('Pending', 'Pending'),
        ('Accepted', 'Accepted'),
        ('InProgress', 'In Progress'),
        ('Completed', 'Completed'),
        ('Cancelled', 'Cancelled')
    )

    booking_id = models.UUIDField(
        primary_key=True,
        default=uuid.uuid4,
        editable=False
    )

    poster_id = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='user_post',
        limit_choices_to={'account_type__in': ['Homeowner', 'Kasambahay']},
        db_column='poster_id'
    )

    booking_type = models.CharField(
        max_length=20,
        choices=BOOKING_TYPE_CHOICES,
        blank=False,
        null=False
    )

    work_setup = models.CharField(
        max_length=8, choices=WORK_SETUP_CHOICES, null=True, blank=True,
        help_text='Agreed work setup; null only for legacy posts without an unambiguous setup.'
    )

    recipient_id = models.ForeignKey(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name='received_booking_offers', null=True, blank=True)
    offer_request_key = models.UUIDField(null=True, blank=True, editable=False)
    offer_payload_hash = models.CharField(max_length=64, blank=True, default='', editable=False)
    work_days = ArrayField(models.CharField(max_length=2, choices=[(day, day) for day in ['M', 'T', 'W', 'Th', 'F', 'S', 'Su']]), default=list, blank=True)
    daily_start_time = models.TimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    daily_end_time = models.TimeField(null=True, blank=True)

    booking_status = models.CharField(
        max_length=20,
        choices=BOOKING_STATUS_CHOICES,
        default='Pending',
        blank=False,
        null=False
    )

    service_category = ArrayField(
        models.CharField(
            max_length=50,
            choices=SERVICES_OFFER_CHOICES
        ),
        blank=False,
        null=False
    )

    start_time = models.DateTimeField(
        blank=False,
        null=False
    )

    end_time = models.DateTimeField(
        blank=True,
        null=True
    )

    region = models.CharField(
        max_length=100,
        blank=True,
        null=True,
        help_text="Philippine region (e.g. Region X - Northern Mindanao)"
    )

    province = models.CharField(
        max_length=100,
        blank=True,
        null=True
    )

    city = models.CharField(
        max_length=100,
        blank=True,
        null=True
    )

    barangay = models.CharField(
        max_length=100,
        blank=True,
        null=True,
        help_text="Barangay name within city/municipality"
    )

    street = models.CharField(
        max_length=255,
        blank=True,
        null=True,
        help_text="House No. / Street / Zone / Subdivision"
    )

    floor_number = models.CharField(
        max_length=50,
        blank=True,
        null=True
    )

    zip_code = models.CharField(
        max_length=4,
        blank=True,
        null=True,
        default='',
        validators=[
            RegexValidator(
                r'^(0[4-9]\d{2}|[1-9]\d{3})$', 
                'Must be a valid 4-digit Philippine Zip Code (0400 or higher).'
            ),
        ]
    )

    special_instruction = models.TextField(
        max_length=1000,
        blank=True,
        null=True
    )

    rate_amount = models.DecimalField(
        max_digits=10,
        decimal_places=2,
        validators=[
            MinValueValidator(Decimal('1.00'))
        ],
        null=False,
        blank=False
    )

    rate_period = models.CharField(max_length=5, choices=[('day', 'Day'), ('month', 'Month')])
    rate_needs_review = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    started_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    completed_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    cancellation_reason = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True, null=True, default='')
    cancelled_by = models.ForeignKey(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, null=True, blank=True,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL, related_name='cancelled_bookings', db_column='cancelled_by')
    cancelled_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    cancellation_penalty_points = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField(default=0)

    createdAt = models.DateTimeField(
        auto_now_add=True
    )

    @property
    def full_address(self):
        barangay = re.sub(r'^(?:brgy\.?|barangay)\s+', '', (self.barangay or '').strip(), flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        parts = [self.street, self.floor_number, f'Brgy. {barangay}' if barangay else '',
                 self.city, self.province, self.zip_code]
        return ', '.join(str(part).strip() for part in parts if part and str(part).strip())

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.service_category} - {self.booking_status}"

    
    class Meta:
        db_table = 'tbl_booking'

        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(fields=['poster_id', 'offer_request_key'], name='unique_chat_offer_request'),
            CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(work_setup__isnull=True) | Q(work_setup__in=['stay_in', 'stay_out']),
                name='valid_booking_work_setup',
            ),

            CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(booking_type__in=['short_term', 'long_term']),
                name='valid_booking_type_enum'
            ),

            CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(booking_status__in=['Pending', 'Accepted', 'InProgress', 'Completed', 'Cancelled']),
                name='valid_booking_status_enum'
            ),

            CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(service_category__contained_by=[
                    'Cleaning', 'Child_care', 'Cooking', 'Caregiver', 'Laundry', 'All-around']),
                    name='validate_service_category_array'
            ),

            CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(service_category__len__gt=0),
                name='service_category_not_empty'
            ),

            CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(end_time__gt=F('start_time')) | Q(end_time__isnull=True),
                name='end_time_after_start_time'
            ),
            
            CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(rate_amount__gte=Decimal('1.00')),
                name='valid_rate_amount'
            ),
            CheckConstraint(
                condition=(Q(booking_type='short_term', rate_period='day') |
                           Q(booking_type='long_term', rate_period='month')),
                name='booking_rate_period_matches_type'
            ),
        ]

class tbl_booking_assignment(models.Model):
    booking_assignment_id = models.UUIDField(primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4, editable=False)
    
    booking_id = models.ForeignKey(

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'tbl_booking_assignment'
        constraints = [models.UniqueConstraint(fields=['booking_id'], name='one_assignment_per_booking')]


class tbl_booking_proposal(models.Model):
    PROPOSAL_STATUS_CHOICES = (
        ('Pending', 'Pending'),

    class Meta:

        constraints = [

            ),

                condition=Q(proposed_rate__gte=Decimal('1.00')),

"""Reposting creates a fresh listing and never changes old applications or agreements."""
import hashlib
import json
from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.db import transaction
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from rest_framework.exceptions import PermissionDenied, ValidationError
from accounts.penalties import assert_booking_unrestricted
from .availability import post_status, schedule_expired
from .models import tbl_booking


@transaction.atomic
def repost_public_post(post_id, actor, schedule, key):
    actor = get_user_model().objects.select_for_update().get(pk=actor.pk)
    assert_booking_unrestricted(actor)
    if not actor.is_active or actor.verification_status != 'Verified':
        raise PermissionDenied('Please complete verification before publishing a post.')
    source = get_object_or_404(tbl_booking.objects.select_for_update(), pk=post_id,
                              poster_id=actor, recipient_id__isnull=True)
    digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps({'action': 'repost', 'post_id': str(post_id), 'schedule': schedule},
                                      sort_keys=True, default=str).encode()).hexdigest()
    existing = tbl_booking.objects.filter(poster_id=actor, offer_request_key=key).first()
    if existing:
        if existing.offer_payload_hash != digest:
            raise ValidationError({'detail': 'This request key has already been used for different post details.'})
        return existing, False
    if post_status(source) != 'Available' or not schedule_expired(source):
        raise ValidationError({'detail': 'Only expired, unbooked public posts can be reposted.'})
    fields = ('booking_type', 'work_setup', 'service_category', 'region', 'province', 'city', 'barangay',
              'street', 'floor_number', 'zip_code', 'special_instruction', 'rate_amount', 'rate_period')
    payload = {field: getattr(source, field) for field in fields}
    payload.update(schedule)
    from .serializers import BookingSerializer
    serializer = BookingSerializer(data=payload)
    # Older posts can have no recorded living setup. Preserve that value;
    # this endpoint only accepts a new schedule, never changed post details.
    if source.work_setup is None:
        serializer.fields['work_setup'].allow_null = True
    serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
    if source.booking_type == 'short_term' and not serializer.validated_data.get('end_time'):
        raise ValidationError({'end_time': 'Choose an end time for this short-term post.'})
    listing = serializer.save(poster_id=actor, offer_request_key=key, offer_payload_hash=digest)
    return listing, True

    street = serializers.CharField(max_length=255, required=False, allow_blank=True, allow_null=True)
    full_address = serializers.ReadOnlyField()

    class Meta:
        model = tbl_booking
        fields = [
            'booking_id',
            'booking_type',
            'work_setup',
            'work_days',
            'daily_start_time',
            'daily_end_time',
            'booking_status',
            'service_category',
            'start_time',
            'end_time',
            'region',

            'city',
            'barangay',
            'street',
            'full_address',
            'floor_number',
            'zip_code',
            'special_instruction',
            'rate_amount',
            'rate_period',
            'rate_needs_review',
            'poster_id',
            'createdAt'
        ]
        read_only_fields = ['booking_id', 'booking_status', 'poster_id', 'createdAt', 'rate_needs_review']

    def validate(self, data):
        # Gracefully handle and discard deprecated service_address if passed
        data.pop('service_address', None)

        # Auto-normalize service_category: if all 5 base services are selected or All-around is combined, normalize to ['All-around']
        service_category = data.get('service_category')
        if isinstance(service_category, list):
            base_services = {'Cleaning', 'Child_care', 'Cooking', 'Caregiver', 'Laundry'}
            current_set = set(service_category)
            if base_services.issubset(current_set) or ('All-around' in current_set and len(current_set) > 1):
                data['service_category'] = ['All-around']

        days = data.get('work_days')
        if days and len(set(days)) != len(days):
            raise serializers.ValidationError({'work_days': 'Select each working day only once.'})
        daily_start, daily_end = data.get('daily_start_time'), data.get('daily_end_time')
        if (daily_start is None) != (daily_end is None):
            raise serializers.ValidationError({'daily_end_time': 'Provide both daily working times.'})
        if daily_start and daily_end and daily_start >= daily_end:
            raise serializers.ValidationError({'daily_end_time': 'The end of the shift must be after its start.'})

        now = timezone.now()
        start_time = data.get('start_time')
        end_time = data.get('end_time')

        # Public posts and chat offers use the same Philippine schedule validation.
        for field, clock in (('start_time', daily_start), ('end_time', daily_end)):
            stamp = data.get(field)
            if stamp and clock and stamp.astimezone(PH_TIME).time().replace(tzinfo=None) != clock:
                raise serializers.ValidationError({field: 'The schedule must match the selected working time in the Philippines.'})
        if start_time and days:
            start_day = ['M', 'T', 'W', 'Th', 'F', 'S', 'Su'][start_time.astimezone(PH_TIME).weekday()]
            short_range = (data.get('booking_type') == 'short_term' and end_time
                and end_time.astimezone(PH_TIME).date() > start_time.astimezone(PH_TIME).date())
            if short_range:
                day_span = (end_time.astimezone(PH_TIME).date() - start_time.astimezone(PH_TIME).date()).days
                weekdays = ['M', 'T', 'W', 'Th', 'F', 'S', 'Su']
                first = start_time.astimezone(PH_TIME).weekday()
                if not any(weekdays[(first + offset) % 7] in days for offset in range(min(day_span + 1, 7))):
                    raise serializers.ValidationError({'work_days': 'Select a working day within the date range.'})
            elif start_day not in days:
                raise serializers.ValidationError({'work_days': 'The start date must fall on a selected working day.'})

        if start_time and start_time <= now: 
            raise serializers.ValidationError({"start_time": "Start time must be in the future."})
        
        if end_time and end_time <= now:
            raise serializers.ValidationError({"end_time": "End time must be in the future."})

        if (start_time and end_time) and end_time <= start_time:
            raise serializers.ValidationError({"end_time": "End time must be strictly after the start time."})

        booking_type = data.get('booking_type') or (self.instance.booking_type if self.instance else None)
        amount = data.get('rate_amount', self.instance.rate_amount if self.instance else None)
        region = data.get('region', self.instance.region if self.instance else '')
        address = ' '.join(str(data.get(key, getattr(self.instance, key, '') if self.instance else '') or '')
                           for key in ('street', 'barangay', 'city', 'province', 'zip_code'))
        validate_rate(amount, booking_type, region, address, period=data.get('rate_period'))
        if data.get('rate_period') is None:
            raise serializers.ValidationError({'rate_period': 'Specify day for short-term or month for long-term.'})

        # Platform minimum uses Philippine calendar dates, not shift hours.
        if booking_type == 'long_term' and start_time and end_time:
            if (end_time.astimezone(PH_TIME).date() - start_time.astimezone(PH_TIME).date()).days < 30:
                raise serializers.ValidationError({
                    'end_time': 'SerbiSure requires at least 30 days for long-term posts. Choose a later end date.'
                })

        return data

    def to_internal_value(self, data):
        # Ignore calendar terms from older APKs, including obsolete date ranges.
        data = data.copy()
        for field in ('start_time', 'end_time', 'work_days'):
            data.pop(field, None)
        return super().to_internal_value(data)

    def validate(self, data):
        data = super().validate(data)
        # start_time is NOT NULL in the existing schema. This storage value is
        # not an agreed service date and must never be displayed as one.
        # Use the current instant, not a future shift start: existing acceptance
        # checks must not mistake the storage placeholder for agreed terms.

        data['work_days'] = []
        return data

"""Authoritative engagement transitions shared by direct and proposal acceptance."""
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.db import transaction
from django.db.models import Q
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from django.utils import timezone
from rest_framework.exceptions import PermissionDenied, ValidationError
from .models import tbl_booking, tbl_booking_assignment, tbl_booking_proposal
from .wage_policy import validate_rate
from accounts.penalties import assert_booking_unrestricted
from .availability import UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE, PASSED_SCHEDULE_MESSAGE

PH_TIME = ZoneInfo('Asia/Manila')
SHORT_TERM_CAP = 3


def month_bounds(at=None):
    current = (at or timezone.now()).astimezone(PH_TIME)
    start = datetime(current.year, current.month, 1, tzinfo=PH_TIME)
    end = datetime(current.year + (current.month == 12), current.month % 12 + 1, 1, tzinfo=PH_TIME)
    return start, end


def pair_booking_count(first_id, second_id, at=None):
    start, end = month_bounds(at)
    # Count the Philippine service-start month, including advance reservations.
    # Accepted cancellations consume a slot: cancelling must not evade the cap.
    return tbl_booking_assignment.objects.filter(
        Q(booking_id__poster_id_id=first_id, accepter_id_id=second_id) |
        Q(booking_id__poster_id_id=second_id, accepter_id_id=first_id),
        booking_id__booking_type='short_term', booking_id__start_time__gte=start, booking_id__start_time__lt=end,
    ).values('booking_id').distinct().count()


def ensure_eligible_pair(poster, accepter):
    if poster.pk == accepter.pk:
        raise ValidationError({'error': 'You cannot accept or propose on your own booking.'})
    if {poster.account_type, accepter.account_type} != {'Homeowner', 'Kasambahay'}:
        raise PermissionDenied('An engagement requires one Homeowner and one Kasambahay.')
    for person in (poster, accepter):
        assert_booking_unrestricted(person)
        if not person.is_active or person.verification_status != 'Verified':
            raise PermissionDenied('Both participants must be active, unrestricted and verified.')
        from accounts.workforce import REQUIRED_DOCUMENTS
        required = REQUIRED_DOCUMENTS[person.account_type]
        from verifications.models import tbl_documents
        valid_types = set(tbl_documents.objects.filter(
            user_profile=person, verification_status='Verified', document_type__in=required,
        ).filter(Q(valid_until__isnull=True) | Q(valid_until__gte=timezone.localdate(timezone=PH_TIME))).values_list('document_type', flat=True))
        if not set(required).issubset(valid_types):
            raise PermissionDenied('Both participants need current approved identity documents.')


def ensure_open(booking, *, require_future=True):
    if booking.booking_status != 'Pending' or booking.assignments.exists():
        raise ValidationError({'code': 'post_unavailable', 'error': UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE})
    if require_future and booking.start_time <= timezone.now():
        raise ValidationError({'code': 'schedule_passed', 'error': PASSED_SCHEDULE_MESSAGE})
    if (booking.booking_type == 'long_term' and booking.end_time
            and (booking.end_time.astimezone(PH_TIME).date() - booking.start_time.astimezone(PH_TIME).date()).days < 30):
        raise ValidationError({'end_time': 'SerbiSure requires at least 30 days for long-term posts. Choose a later end date.'})
    if booking.rate_needs_review:
        raise ValidationError({'error': 'The poster must confirm the monthly amount on this legacy post before it can be accepted.'})


def close_other_applications(booking, selected_user):
    from notifications.services import send_in_app_notification
    selected = booking.proposals.filter(proposer_id=selected_user, status='Pending')
    selected.update(status='Accepted')
    others = booking.proposals.filter(status='Pending').exclude(proposer_id=selected_user)
    recipients = {row.proposer_id_id: row.proposer_id for row in others.select_related('proposer_id')}
    others.update(status='Rejected')
    for person in recipients.values():
        send_in_app_notification(receiver=person, sender=booking.poster_id,
            message='A post you applied to has been booked. Your application is closed / not selected.')
    from realtime.events import publish
    publish([booking.poster_id_id, selected_user.pk, *recipients], {'type': 'booking.changed', 'booking_id': str(booking.pk)})


def enforce_pair_cap(booking, accepter):
    if booking.booking_type == 'short_term' and pair_booking_count(booking.poster_id_id, accepter.pk, booking.start_time) >= SHORT_TERM_CAP:
        raise ValidationError({'code': 'short_term_monthly_cap',
                               'error': 'This pair has reached three short-term bookings this month. Use a long-term engagement and the DOLE contract form to continue.'})


def lock_participants(poster_id, accepter_id):
    # Stable user locks serialize the pair across different listings, not just one post.
    users = list(get_user_model().objects.select_for_update(no_key=True).filter(pk__in=[poster_id, accepter_id]).order_by('pk'))
    return {person.pk: person for person in users}


@transaction.atomic
def accept_engagement(booking_id, actor, proposal_id=None):
    preview = get_object_or_404(tbl_booking, pk=booking_id)
    proposal = get_object_or_404(tbl_booking_proposal, pk=proposal_id, booking_id=preview) if proposal_id else None
    if proposal and preview.poster_id_id != actor.pk:
        raise PermissionDenied('Only the poster can accept this proposal.')
    accepter_id = proposal.proposer_id_id if proposal else actor.pk
    people = lock_participants(preview.poster_id_id, accepter_id)
    booking = get_object_or_404(tbl_booking.objects.select_for_update(), pk=booking_id)
    poster, accepter = people[booking.poster_id_id], people[accepter_id]
    ensure_eligible_pair(poster, accepter)
    if booking.recipient_id_id and booking.recipient_id_id != accepter.pk:
        raise PermissionDenied('This private offer is addressed to another participant.')
    ensure_open(booking)
    if proposal:
        proposal = tbl_booking_proposal.objects.select_for_update().get(pk=proposal.pk)
        if proposal.status != 'Pending':
            raise ValidationError({'error': 'This proposal has already been resolved.'})
    amount = proposal.proposed_rate if proposal else booking.rate_amount
    validate_rate(amount, booking.booking_type, booking.region, booking.full_address, period=booking.rate_period)
    enforce_pair_cap(booking, accepter)
    booking.rate_amount = amount
    booking.booking_status = 'Accepted'
    booking.save(update_fields=['rate_amount', 'booking_status'])
    tbl_booking_assignment.objects.create(booking_id=booking, accepter_id=accepter)
    if proposal:
        proposal.status = 'Accepted'
        proposal.save(update_fields=['status'])
    close_other_applications(booking, accepter)
    return booking, accepter


@transaction.atomic
def create_proposal(booking_id, actor, amount, period, message, *, apply_at_posted_rate=False):
    preview = get_object_or_404(tbl_booking, pk=booking_id)
    people = lock_participants(preview.poster_id_id, actor.pk)
    from chat.moderation import inspect_outgoing
    message = inspect_outgoing(people[actor.pk], people[preview.poster_id_id], message, channel='proposal')
    booking = get_object_or_404(tbl_booking.objects.select_for_update(), pk=booking_id)
    ensure_eligible_pair(people[booking.poster_id_id], people[actor.pk])
    if booking.recipient_id_id and booking.recipient_id_id != actor.pk:
        raise PermissionDenied('This private offer is addressed to another participant.')
    if apply_at_posted_rate:
        if booking.poster_id.account_type != 'Homeowner' or booking.recipient_id_id:
            raise ValidationError({'error': 'Applications are only available on public job posts.'})
        ensure_open(booking, require_future=False)
        existing = booking.proposals.filter(proposer_id=actor, status__in=['Pending', 'Accepted']).order_by('-createdAt').first()
        if existing:
            return existing, False
        amount, period = booking.rate_amount, booking.rate_period
    ensure_open(booking, require_future=False)
    amount = validate_rate(amount, booking.booking_type, booking.region, booking.full_address,
                           field='proposed_rate', period=period)
    enforce_pair_cap(booking, actor)
    if booking.proposals.filter(proposer_id=actor, status='Pending').exists():
        raise ValidationError({'error': 'You already have a pending proposal for this post.'})
    return tbl_booking_proposal.objects.create(booking_id=booking, proposer_id=actor,
                                                proposed_rate=amount, message=message), True

class JobApplicationTests(APITestCase):

    def test_application_uses_posted_rate_sends_message_and_appears_in_applied(self):

        self.assertEqual(tbl_chat_message.objects.filter(is_booking_offer=True).count(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(tbl_chat_message.objects.get(is_booking_offer=False).message_payload, self.body['message'])
        self.assertEqual(tbl_notification.objects.filter(receiver_id=self.owner).count(), 1)

    def test_repeated_application_returns_original_without_duplicate_side_effects(self):
        first = self.client.post(self.url, self.body, format='json')
        for _ in range(3):
            repeated = self.client.post(self.url, self.body, format='json')
            self.assertEqual(repeated.status_code, 200, repeated.data)

        self.assertEqual(tbl_chat_message.objects.count(), 2)

        self.assertEqual(len(self.client.get(reverse('booking-my-proposals')).data), 1)

    def test_application_pass_works_in_chat_and_details_and_tracks_selection(self):
        detail_url = reverse('booking-detail', kwargs={'booking_id': self.listing.pk})
        thread_url = reverse('chat-thread', kwargs={'partner_id': self.owner.pk})
        self.assertIsNone(self.client.get(detail_url).data['pass_url'])

        application = self.client.post(self.url, self.body, format='json')
        self.assertEqual(application.status_code, 201, application.data)
        pass_url = self.client.get(detail_url).data['pass_url']
        messages = self.client.get(thread_url).data['data']
        offer = next(message['booking_offer'] for message in messages if message['booking_offer'])
        self.assertTrue(offer['booking']['pass_url'])
        self.assertEqual(offer['status'], 'Pending')

        def scan(url):
            parts = urlsplit(url)
            return APIClient().get(f'{parts.path}?{parts.query}')

        for url in (pass_url, offer['booking']['pass_url']):
            pending = scan(url)
            self.assertEqual(pending.status_code, 200)
            self.assertEqual(pending.context['pass_state'], 'pending')
            self.assertFalse(pending.context['entry_allowed'])
            self.assertNotIn('worker', pending.context)

        other = create_verified_test_user(username='another-applicant', email='another-applicant@test.com',
                                          account_type='Kasambahay', verification_status='Verified')
        self.client.force_authenticate(other)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.post(self.url, self.body, format='json').status_code, 201)

        self.assertEqual(scan(other_pass).status_code, 200)

        self.client.force_authenticate(self.owner)
        accepted = self.client.patch(

            {'action': 'accept'}, format='json',
        )
        self.assertEqual(accepted.status_code, 200, accepted.data)
        self.client.force_authenticate(self.worker)
        refreshed = self.client.get(detail_url).data
        self.assertEqual(refreshed['booking_status'], 'Accepted')
        self.assertTrue(refreshed['pass_url'])
        self.assertEqual(scan(pass_url).status_code, 200)
        self.client.force_authenticate(other)
        self.assertIsNone(self.client.get(detail_url).data['pass_url'])
        self.assertEqual(scan(other_pass).status_code, 404)

    def test_passed_schedule_can_be_applied_to_once_but_cannot_be_accepted(self):
        self.listing.start_time = timezone.now()-timedelta(days=1)

    def test_existing_counter_offer_is_preserved(self):

    def test_closed_unverified_own_service_and_private_posts_cannot_be_applied_to(self):

        self.listing.save(update_fields=['recipient_id'])

        service_url = reverse('booking-proposals-create', kwargs={'booking_id': post(self.worker).pk})
        self.assertEqual(self.client.post(service_url, self.body, format='json').status_code, 400)

        self.assertEqual(self.client.post(self.url, self.body, format='json').status_code, 403)

    def test_invalid_application_flag_is_rejected(self):
        response = self.client.post(self.url, {**self.body, 'apply_at_posted_rate': 'false'}, format='json')
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)

    def test_message_failure_rolls_back_the_application(self):
        create = tbl_chat_message.objects.create

        def fail_plain_message(**kwargs):
            if not kwargs.get('is_booking_offer'):
                raise RuntimeError('Simulated message failure')
            return create(**kwargs)

        with patch('chat.models.tbl_chat_message.objects.create', side_effect=fail_plain_message):
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                self.client.post(self.url, self.body, format='json')
        self.assertFalse(tbl_booking_proposal.objects.exists())

class ConcurrentJobApplicationTests(BookingTransactionTestCase):
    def test_simultaneous_taps_create_one_application_and_one_message_pair(self):
        owner, worker = participants()
        listing = post(owner)
        url = reverse('booking-proposals-create', kwargs={'booking_id': listing.pk})
        barrier = Barrier(2)

        def apply(_):
            close_old_connections()
            try:
                client = APIClient()
                client.force_authenticate(worker)
                barrier.wait(timeout=10)
                response = client.post(url, {'apply_at_posted_rate': True,
                    'message': 'I am interested in this job position'}, format='json')
                return response.status_code, response.data['proposal']['proposal_id']
            finally:
                close_old_connections()

        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
            results = list(pool.map(apply, range(2)))
        self.assertCountEqual([code for code, _ in results], [201, 200])
        self.assertEqual(len({proposal for _, proposal in results}), 1)
        self.assertEqual(tbl_booking_proposal.objects.count(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(tbl_chat_message.objects.count(), 2)
        self.assertEqual(tbl_notification.objects.filter(receiver_id=owner).count(), 1)

class ChatOfferTests(APITestCase):

        self.other = create_verified_test_user(email='chat-other@test.com', username='chat-other', password='test', account_type='Kasambahay', verification_status='Verified')
        self.key = str(uuid4())

    def payload(self, recipient):
        start = (timezone.now().astimezone(PH_TIME)+timedelta(days=2)).replace(hour=8, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
        return dict(recipient_id=str(recipient.pk), booking_type='long_term', work_setup='stay_out',
            service_category=['Cleaning'], rate_amount='8000', rate_period='month',
            start_time=start.isoformat(), end_time=(start+timedelta(days=30, hours=9)).isoformat(),
            daily_start_time='08:00:00', daily_end_time='17:00:00', work_days=[['M', 'T', 'W', 'Th', 'F', 'S', 'Su'][start.weekday()]],
            region='Region X', street='Test agreed work address')

    def send(self, sender, recipient, **updates):
        self.client.force_authenticate(sender)
        data = self.payload(recipient)
        data.update(updates)
        return self.client.post(reverse('booking-chat-offer'), data, format='json', HTTP_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=self.key)

    def test_either_role_can_send_and_only_counterpart_can_confirm(self):
        for sender, recipient in ((self.owner, self.worker), (self.worker, self.owner)):
            self.key = str(uuid4())
            response = self.send(sender, recipient)
            self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 201, response.data)
            row = tbl_booking.objects.get(pk=response.data['booking']['booking_id'])
            self.assertEqual(row.booking_status, 'Pending')
            self.assertEqual(row.work_days, self.payload(recipient)['work_days'])
            self.assertEqual(str(row.daily_start_time), '08:00:00')
            self.assertFalse(response.data['chat_message']['booking_offer']['can_respond'])
            pass_url = response.data['chat_message']['booking_offer']['booking']['pass_url']
            self.assertEqual(signing.loads(parse_qs(urlsplit(pass_url).query)['token'][0],
                salt=GATE_PASS_SALT, max_age=GATE_PASS_MAX_AGE), str(row.pk))
            self.assertEqual(self.client.patch(reverse('booking-accept', kwargs={'booking_id': row.pk})).status_code, 400)
            self.client.force_authenticate(self.other)

            messages = thread['data'] if isinstance(thread, dict) else thread
            self.assertTrue(messages[-1]['booking_offer']['can_respond'])

            self.assertEqual(self.client.patch(reverse('booking-accept', kwargs={'booking_id': row.pk})).status_code, 200)
            row.refresh_from_db()

            thread = self.client.get(reverse('chat-thread', kwargs={'partner_id': sender.pk})).data
            messages = thread['data'] if isinstance(thread, dict) else thread
            self.assertEqual(messages[-1]['booking_offer']['status'], 'Confirmed')

    def test_idempotency_is_durable_and_changed_terms_cannot_reuse_key(self):
        self.client.force_authenticate(self.owner)
        data = self.payload(self.worker)
        response = self.client.post(reverse('booking-chat-offer'), data, format='json', HTTP_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=self.key)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 201)
        repeated = self.client.post(reverse('booking-chat-offer'), data, format='json', HTTP_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=self.key)
        self.assertEqual(repeated.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(response.data['booking']['booking_id'], repeated.data['booking']['booking_id'])
        self.assertEqual(tbl_booking.objects.count(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(tbl_chat_message.objects.count(), 1)
        data['rate_amount'] = '9000'
        self.assertEqual(self.client.post(reverse('booking-chat-offer'), data, format='json', HTTP_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=self.key).status_code, 400)

    def source_post(self, poster, **updates):
        values = dict(poster_id=poster, booking_type='short_term', work_setup='stay_out',
            service_category=['Cleaning'], rate_amount='800', rate_period='day', region='Region X',
            start_time=timezone.now()+timedelta(days=2))
        values.update(updates)
        return tbl_booking.objects.create(**values)

    def test_invalid_key_and_recipient_have_separate_messages(self):
        self.client.force_authenticate(self.owner)
        url = reverse('booking-chat-offer')
        response = self.client.post(url, self.payload(self.worker), format='json',
            HTTP_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY='booking-offer-123-random')
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)
        self.assertIn('request key', str(response.data))
        self.assertNotIn('recipient', str(response.data))
        for recipient in (None, '', 'not-a-uuid'):
            data = {**self.payload(self.worker), 'recipient_id': recipient}
            response = self.client.post(url, data, format='json', HTTP_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=self.key)
            self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)
            self.assertIn('recipient_id', response.data)
        self.assertFalse(tbl_booking.objects.exists())

    def test_legacy_source_parameter_is_ignored_and_never_links_bookings(self):
        listing = self.source_post(self.owner, start_time=timezone.now()-timedelta(days=1))
        response = self.send(self.owner, self.worker, source_post_id=str(listing.pk))
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 201, response.data)
        listing.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(listing.booking_status, 'Pending')
        self.assertNotIn('source_post', {field.name for field in tbl_booking._meta.fields})
        self.assertFalse(listing.assignments.exists())

    def test_invalid_terms_and_message_failure_do_not_leave_partial_offers(self):
        for field, value in [('rate_amount', '100'), ('work_days', []), ('street', ''), ('daily_end_time', '07:00:00')]:
            response = self.send(self.owner, self.worker, **{field: value})
            self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400, response.data)
        self.assertEqual(tbl_booking.objects.count(), 0)
        with patch('chat.models.tbl_chat_message.objects.create', side_effect=RuntimeError('database failure')):
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                self.send(self.owner, self.worker)
        self.assertEqual(tbl_booking.objects.count(), 0)
        self.assertEqual(tbl_chat_message.objects.count(), 0)

    def test_private_receiver_can_decline_and_legacy_text_never_becomes_evidence(self):
        response = self.send(self.owner, self.worker)
        row_id = response.data['booking']['booking_id']
        self.client.force_authenticate(self.worker)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.patch(reverse('booking-cancel', kwargs={'booking_id': row_id}), {'reason': 'Other'}, format='json').status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.patch(reverse('booking-accept', kwargs={'booking_id': row_id})).status_code, 400)
        legacy = tbl_chat_message.objects.create(sender_id=self.owner, receiver_id=self.worker,
            message_payload='[BOOKING]: {"isConfirmed":true,"salary":"999999"}')
        from chat.serializers import ChatMessageSerializer
        self.assertIsNone(ChatMessageSerializer(legacy).data['booking_offer'])

    def test_existing_post_proposals_link_to_chat_and_reject_competitors(self):
        row = tbl_booking.objects.create(poster_id=self.owner, booking_type='short_term', work_setup='stay_out',
            service_category=['Cleaning'], rate_amount='800', rate_period='day', region='Region X',
            start_time=timezone.now()+timedelta(days=2))
        competitor = tbl_booking_proposal.objects.create(booking_id=row, proposer_id=self.other, proposed_rate='800')
        self.client.force_authenticate(self.worker)
        response = self.client.post(reverse('booking-proposals-create', kwargs={'booking_id': row.pk}),
            {'proposed_rate': '900', 'rate_period': 'day'}, format='json')
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 201, response.data)
        message = tbl_chat_message.objects.get(booking_proposal_id=response.data['proposal']['proposal_id'])
        self.assertTrue(message.is_booking_offer)
        self.client.force_authenticate(self.owner)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.patch(reverse('booking-proposals-respond', kwargs={'proposal_id': message.booking_proposal_id}), {'action': 'accept'}, format='json').status_code, 200)
        competitor.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(competitor.status, 'Rejected')
        self.assertEqual(tbl_booking_assignment.objects.get(booking_id=row).accepter_id, self.worker)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(reverse('booking-my-proposals')).data, [])
        self.client.force_authenticate(self.worker)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(reverse('booking-my-proposals')).data[0]['booking_id'], str(row.pk))
        self.client.force_authenticate(self.other)
        history = self.client.get(reverse('booking-my-proposals')).data
        self.assertEqual(len(history), 1)
        self.assertEqual(history[0]['application_status'], 'not_selected')

    def test_restrictions_are_rechecked_at_acceptance_and_offer_stays_pending_on_error(self):
        response = self.send(self.owner, self.worker)
        row_id = response.data['booking']['booking_id']
        self.worker.is_restricted = True
        self.worker.save(update_fields=['is_restricted'])
        self.client.force_authenticate(self.worker)
        response = self.client.patch(reverse('booking-accept', kwargs={'booking_id': row_id}))
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 403)
        self.assertEqual(tbl_booking.objects.get(pk=row_id).booking_status, 'Pending')
        self.assertFalse(tbl_booking_assignment.objects.exists())

    def test_private_terms_cannot_be_changed_or_forwarded_to_another_user(self):
        response = self.send(self.owner, self.worker)
        row_id = response.data['booking']['booking_id']
        self.assertEqual(self.client.patch(reverse('booking-rate-review', kwargs={'booking_id': row_id}),
            {'rate_amount': '9000', 'rate_period': 'month'}, format='json').status_code, 400)
        response = self.client.post(reverse('chat-send'), {'receiver_id': str(self.other.pk),
            'booking_id': row_id, 'message_payload': 'Forwarded private terms'}, format='json', HTTP_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=str(uuid4()))
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400, response.data)

    def test_inconsistent_timezone_terms_are_rejected(self):
        response = self.send(self.owner, self.worker, daily_start_time='09:00:00')
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)
        self.assertFalse(tbl_booking.objects.exists())
